text.zh: 以厘米为单位量长度；使用缩写 cm；比较和排列以厘米为单位的长度；量出和画出长度精确到厘米的线段

text.zh: 在点阵或方格纸上临摹图形

text.en: measuring length in metres; using appropriate units of measurement and their abbreviations m, g, kg, ℓ
text.zh: 以米为单位量长度；使用合适的计量单位及其缩写 m、g、kg、ℓ

text.zh: 平面图形面积和周长的概念

text.zh: 以平方单位、cm² 和 m² 量面积，不包括 cm² 与 m² 之间的换算

text.zh: 已知长方形的一条边和它的面积或周长，求另一条边

text.zh: 求由长方形和正方形组成的组合图形的面积和周长

caption.en: Two placemats of different shapes. Which one covers more of the table? It is hard to tell just by looking.
caption.zh: 两张形状不同的餐垫。哪一张盖住的桌面多？光看不好说。

caption.en: Cover the first mat with squares that are all the same size. It takes 12 squares.
caption.zh: 用同样大的正方形把第一张铺满，要 12 块。

caption.en: The second mat also takes 12 of the same squares. Different shapes can cover the same amount: they have the same area.
caption.zh: 第二张也要 12 块同样的正方形。形状不同，盖住的一样多：面积相同。

caption.en: Counting 3 big squares on one mat and 12 small ones on the other does not compare them. Area is measured with squares of one size.
caption.zh: 一张数 3 块大的，一张数 12 块小的，没法比。量面积要用同样大的正方形。

keyFacts.en: Area is how much surface a shape covers.
keyFacts.zh: 面积是图形盖住的面有多大。

keyFacts.en: Measure it by counting squares of one size.
keyFacts.zh: 用同样大的正方形去数。

prompt.en: Cover the rug with squares, then write how many squares it takes.
prompt.zh: 用正方形铺满这块地毯，再写出用了几块。

guide.en: Lay a square on every cell of the rug, a row at a time if you like. The number of squares that cover it is its area.
guide.zh: 在地毯的每一格上铺一块正方形，可以一行一行地铺。铺满它用的正方形个数就是它的面积。

hints.en: Tap a cell, or a row head, to lay squares.
hints.zh: 点一格，或点行首的按钮，就能铺上正方形。

hints.en: Every cell inside the outline needs one square.
hints.zh: 轮廓里的每一格都要铺一块。

hints.en: 3 rows of 5 squares.
hints.zh: 3 行，每行 5 块。

correct.en: Yes. 15 squares of the same size cover the rug: its area is 15 square units.
correct.zh: 对。15 块同样大的正方形铺满了地毯：面积是 15 平方单位。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count the squares that cover the rug again, row by row.
fallback.zh: 还没对。一行一行地再数一遍铺满地毯的正方形。

reveal.en: 3 rows of 5 squares cover it: 15 squares, an area of 15 square units.
reveal.zh: 3 行、每行 5 块，一共 15 块：面积是 15 平方单位。

text.en: They have the same area: both take 8 small squares.
text.zh: 面积一样：都要 8 块小正方形。

text.en: A has the bigger area: 8 squares is more than 2.
text.zh: A 的面积大：8 块比 2 块多。

text.en: B has the bigger area: its squares are bigger.
text.zh: B 的面积大：它的正方形大。

prompt.en: Mat A is covered by 8 squares and mat B by 2 bigger squares. Which is right?
prompt.zh: 餐垫 A 铺了 8 块正方形，餐垫 B 铺了 2 块大正方形。哪句话对？

guide.en: To compare areas, both shapes must be measured with squares of the same size. Look at the size of the squares before you compare the counts.
guide.zh: 比较面积时，两个图形要用同样大的正方形去量。比个数之前，先看看正方形一样不一样大。

hints.en: Are the squares on the two mats the same size?
hints.zh: 两张餐垫上的正方形一样大吗？

hints.en: One big square on B covers 4 small squares.
hints.zh: B 上的一块大正方形能盖住 4 块小正方形。

correct.en: Yes. Measured with the same small squares, B also takes 8: the two mats have the same area.
correct.zh: 对。用同样的小正方形量，B 也要 8 块：两张餐垫面积相同。

say.en: 2 big squares and 8 small squares cannot be compared by their counts. Measure both mats with squares of one size.
say.zh: 2 块大的和 8 块小的，不能直接比个数。两张餐垫要用同样大的正方形来量。

fallback.en: Not yet. Compare the sizes of the squares first, then count.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先比一比正方形的大小，再数。

reveal.en: Each big square covers 4 small ones, so B takes 2 × 4 = 8 small squares, the same as A.
reveal.zh: 每块大正方形盖住 4 块小的，所以 B 要 2 × 4 = 8 块小正方形，和 A 一样。

prompt.en: Cover the square card with unit squares, then write its area.
prompt.zh: 用单位正方形铺满这张正方形卡片，再写出面积。

guide.en: Lay one square on each cell inside the card. Count all the squares you use, one row at a time.
guide.zh: 在卡片里的每一格铺一块正方形。一行一行地数，把铺上的正方形全部数完。

hints.en: Look at the cells inside the card.
hints.zh: 看看卡片里面的方格。

hints.en: Cover every row with squares of the same size.
hints.zh: 用同样大的正方形把每一行铺满。

hints.en: There are 3 rows, with 3 squares in each row.
hints.zh: 共有 3 行，每行 3 块正方形。

correct.en: Yes. 9 equal squares cover the card, so its area is 9 square units.
correct.zh: 对。9 块同样大的正方形铺满卡片，面积是 9 平方单位。

say.en: Counting 3 across and 3 up does not count all the covered cells. Look at the squares in every row.
say.zh: 6 只数了一行和一列。要数铺满卡片的全部格子：3 行，每行 3 块。

fallback.en: Not yet. Cover and count each cell inside the card once.
fallback.zh: 还没对。把卡片里的每一格铺满，每格数一次。

reveal.en: Count the first row: 3 squares. The next two rows bring the count to 6, then 9. The area is 9 square units.
reveal.zh: 第一行有 3 块。接着数第二行、第三行，数到 6，再数到 9。面积是 9 平方单位。

prompt.en: Cover the notice board with unit squares, then write its area.
prompt.zh: 用单位正方形铺满告示板，再写出面积。

guide.en: Each cell needs one unit square. Keep counting as you cover the rows of the board.
guide.zh: 每一格都要铺一块单位正方形。一行一行地铺，接着往下数。

hints.en: Find the four rows inside the board.
hints.zh: 先数一数告示板有几行。

hints.en: Lay a square on every cell in each row.
hints.zh: 在每一行的每一格铺一块正方形。

hints.en: After three rows you have counted 18 squares; one row remains.
hints.zh: 数完三行是 18 块，还剩一行。

correct.en: Yes. 24 equal squares cover the board: its area is 24 square units.
correct.zh: 对。24 块同样大的正方形铺满告示板，面积是 24 平方单位。

say.en: Counting 6 across and 4 up leaves many covered cells uncounted. Count every square in all four rows.
say.zh: 10 只数了一行和一列，漏了里面的许多格子。要把 4 行里的正方形都数完。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count all four rows of covered squares, keeping one running count.
fallback.zh: 还没对。接着往下数，把四行铺上的正方形数完。

reveal.en: Counting the rows gives 6, then 12, then 18, then 24 squares. The area is 24 square units.
reveal.zh: 一行一行地数，数到 6、12、18，最后是 24 块。面积是 24 平方单位。

prompt.en: Cover the shaded figure with unit squares, then write its area.
prompt.zh: 用单位正方形铺满涂色图形，再写出面积。

guide.en: Cover only the cells inside the shaded figure. Count each square once, including those beside the missing corner.
guide.zh: 只铺涂色图形里面的格子。每块正方形数一次，缺角旁边的格子也要铺满。

hints.en: Look at where the shaded figure stops near its top-right corner.
hints.zh: 看看图形右上角缺了哪些格子。

hints.en: Count the shaded cells row by row; leave the unshaded cells empty.
hints.zh: 一行一行地数涂色格子，没涂色的格子不要铺。

hints.en: From the top, the rows have 2, 2, 4 and 4 squares.
hints.zh: 从上往下，各行有 2、2、4、4 块正方形。

correct.en: Yes. 12 equal squares cover the shaded figure, so its area is 12 square units.
correct.zh: 对。12 块同样大的正方形铺满涂色图形，面积是 12 平方单位。

say.en: 16 counts the empty corner as well. Look at the four unshaded cells at the top right; they are outside the figure.
say.zh: 16 把缺角也数进去了。右上角四个没涂色的格子在图形外面，不用铺。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count only the squares that cover the shaded cells.
fallback.zh: 还没对。只数铺满涂色格子的正方形。

reveal.en: Count from the top: 2 squares, then 4, then 8, then 12 altogether. The area is 12 square units.
reveal.zh: 从上往下数，先是 2 块，接着数到 4、8，最后是 12 块。面积是 12 平方单位。

prompt.en: Which figure covers more of the grid, A or B?
prompt.zh: A 和 B，哪个图形盖住的方格多？

guide.en: Use the same small grid squares to measure both figures. Count only cells inside each figure.
guide.zh: 用同样大的小方格来量两个图形，只数图形里面的格子。

hints.en: Look closely at B's missing corner.
hints.zh: 仔细看看 B 的缺角。

hints.en: Count A and B row by row, leaving unshaded cells out.
hints.zh: 一行一行地数 A 和 B，没涂色的格子不要数。

hints.en: A has 9 squares. B has rows of 2, 2 and 4 squares.
hints.zh: A 有 9 格。B 从上往下各行有 2、2、4 格。

text.en: B covers more: I counted all 12 cells in its surrounding rectangle.
text.zh: B 盖住的多：我数了它外面长方形里的全部 12 格。

correct.en: Yes. A covers 9 equal grid squares and B covers 8, so A has the bigger area.
correct.zh: 对。A 盖住 9 格，B 盖住 8 格，方格一样大，所以 A 的面积大。

say.en: The surrounding rectangle includes four cells that B does not cover. Look at B's missing corner before counting its squares.
say.zh: 外面的长方形里有四格没有被 B 盖住。数 B 的格子时，留意它的缺角。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count the shaded grid squares in each figure again.
fallback.zh: 还没对。再数一遍两个图形盖住的方格。

reveal.en: A covers 9 squares. Counting B's shaded rows gives 8 squares. A covers one more square.
reveal.zh: A 盖住 9 格。数 B 的涂色行，一共 8 格。A 多盖住一格。

prompt.en: Mat A takes 12 small squares; B takes 4 big squares. Which mat covers more?
prompt.zh: 餐垫 A 铺了 12 块小正方形，B 铺了 4 块大的。哪张盖住的多？

guide.en: Check the sizes of the covering squares. Use the small grid squares for both mats before comparing their counts.
guide.zh: 先看看铺上的正方形有多大。两张餐垫都用方格里的小正方形来数，再比较个数。

hints.en: Look at the small grid cells inside one big square on B.
hints.zh: 看看 B 的一块大正方形里面有几个小格。

hints.en: Each big square covers 4 small grid squares. Count B using the small squares.
hints.zh: 每块大正方形盖住 4 个小格。用小格来数 B。

hints.en: B has four rows of 4 small squares. A has 12 small squares.
hints.zh: B 有四行小格，每行 4 格。A 有 12 个小格。

text.en: A covers more: 12 squares is more than 4 squares.
text.zh: A 盖住的多：12 块比 4 块多。

text.en: B covers more when both mats are counted in small grid squares.
text.zh: 两张都用小格来数，B 盖住的多。

correct.en: Yes. B covers 16 small grid squares and A covers 12, so B has the bigger area.
correct.zh: 对。B 盖住 16 个小格，A 盖住 12 个，所以 B 的面积大。

say.en: 12 small squares and 4 big squares use different sizes. Look inside B's big squares and compare both mats in small grid squares.
say.zh: 12 块小的和 4 块大的，正方形大小不同，不能直接比块数。先数出 B 的一块大正方形里有几个小格，再用小格比较两张餐垫。

fallback.en: Not yet. Compare both mats using squares of the same size.
fallback.zh: 还没对。用同样大的正方形比较两张餐垫。

reveal.en: Count B's small squares row by row: 4, 8, 12, 16. A covers 12, so B covers 4 more small squares.
reveal.zh: 一行一行数 B 的小格，数到 4、8、12、16。A 盖住 12 格，所以 B 多盖住 4 格。

prompt.en: Which two figures cover the same number of small grid squares?
prompt.zh: 哪两个图形盖住的小格个数相同？

guide.en: Count the small squares inside A, B and C. Shapes can look different and still cover the same number of squares.
guide.zh: 数一数 A、B、C 里面的小格。形状不同，也可以盖住同样多个小格。

hints.en: Look at all the shaded rows in each figure.
hints.zh: 看看每个图形的所有涂色行。

hints.en: Leave out the two empty cells at C's top-right corner.
hints.zh: C 右上角的两个空格不要数。

hints.en: A covers 6 squares. B's rows have 2 and 4 squares.
hints.zh: A 盖住 6 格。B 的两行分别有 2 格和 4 格。

text.en: A and C: both fit in a rectangle of 6 cells.
text.zh: A 和 C：外面的长方形都是 6 格。

correct.en: Yes. A and B each cover 6 equal squares, so they have the same area.
correct.zh: 对。A 和 B 各盖住 6 个同样大的小格，所以面积相同。

say.en: C does not cover every cell of its surrounding rectangle. Look at its two empty corner cells and count only the shaded squares.
say.zh: C 没有盖住外面长方形的每一格。看看缺角里的两个空格，只数涂色格子。

fallback.en: Not yet. Compare the number of shaded small squares in each figure.
fallback.zh: 还没对。比较每个图形里面涂色小格的个数。

reveal.en: A covers 6 squares, B covers 6, and C covers 4. A and B have the same area of 6 square units.
reveal.zh: A 盖住 6 格，B 盖住 6 格，C 盖住 4 格。A 和 B 的面积相同，都是 6 平方单位。

prompt.en: Which two figures have the same area? Use squares of the same size.
prompt.zh: 用同样大的正方形量，哪两个图形的面积相同？

guide.en: Count every figure in small grid squares. Compare the counts only after checking that you used squares of one size.
guide.zh: 每个图形都用小格来数。先确认正方形一样大，再比较个数。

hints.en: C is covered by bigger squares than D.
hints.zh: C 铺上的正方形比 D 的大。

hints.en: Use the small grid squares to count A and B as well as C and D.
hints.zh: A、B、C、D 都用方格里的小格来数。

hints.en: A has four rows of 2 squares. B has rows of 2, 3 and 3 squares.
hints.zh: A 有四行，每行 2 格。B 从上往下各行有 2、3、3 格。

text.en: C and D: each is covered by 3 squares.
text.zh: C 和 D：都铺了 3 块正方形。

correct.en: Yes. A and B each cover 8 small grid squares, so their areas are equal.
correct.zh: 对。A 和 B 各盖住 8 个小格，所以面积相同。

say.en: C's 3 squares are bigger than D's 3 squares. Look at the small cells inside C's squares before comparing C and D.
say.zh: C 的 3 块正方形比 D 的 3 块大，块数一样，面积不一定一样。先看 C 的一块大正方形里有几个小格。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count both figures with squares of the same size before pairing them.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先用同样大的正方形量，再选出面积相同的一对。

reveal.en: A and B each cover 8 small squares. C covers 12 small squares and D covers 3, so the equal-area pair is A and B.
reveal.zh: A 和 B 各盖住 8 个小格。C 盖住 12 个小格，D 盖住 3 个，所以面积相同的是 A 和 B。

caption.en: A square with sides of 1 cm has an area of 1 square centimetre, written 1 cm².
caption.zh: 边长 1 cm 的正方形，面积是 1 平方厘米，写作 1 cm²。

caption.en: This shape is covered by 8 of these squares, so its area is 8 cm². The small 2 means square centimetres; 8 cm would be a length.
caption.zh: 这个图形铺了 8 个这样的正方形，面积是 8 cm²。右上角的小 2 表示“平方”；写成 8 cm 就成了长度。

caption.en: Two half squares make one whole square. This shape is 6 whole squares and 2 halves: 7 cm².
caption.zh: 两个半格合起来是一个整格。这个图形是 6 个整格加 2 个半格：7 cm²。

caption.en: Bigger surfaces, like a bedroom floor, are measured in square metres. A square 1 m by 1 m is 1 m². This floor is 12 m².
caption.zh: 大一些的面，比如卧室的地面，用平方米来量。边长 1 m 的正方形是 1 m²。这块地面是 12 m²。

keyFacts.en: 1 cm² is the area of a square with 1 cm sides; 1 m² has 1 m sides.
keyFacts.zh: 1 cm² 是边长 1 cm 的正方形的面积，1 m² 是边长 1 m 的。

keyFacts.en: Two half squares make one square.
keyFacts.zh: 两个半格是一个整格。

prompt.en: Each square is 1 cm². What is the area of the card? Write the number and choose the unit.
prompt.zh: 每一格是 1 cm²。这张卡片的面积是多少？写出数，再选单位。

guide.en: Count the 1 cm squares that cover the card. Area is a number of squares, so its unit is a square unit: cm².
guide.zh: 数一数盖住卡片的 1 cm 正方形。面积数的是正方形，所以单位是平方单位：cm²。

hints.en: Count the squares row by row.
hints.zh: 一行一行地数格子。

hints.en: 3 rows of 4 squares, each 1 cm².
hints.zh: 3 行，每行 4 格，每格 1 cm²。

hints.en: 12 squares of 1 cm²: choose cm².
hints.zh: 12 个 1 cm²：选 cm²。

correct.en: Yes. 12 squares of 1 cm² cover the card: 12 cm².
correct.zh: 对。12 个 1 cm² 的正方形盖住卡片：12 cm²。

say.en: 12 is right, but cm is a unit of length. Area counts squares, so write cm².
say.zh: 12 对了，可 cm 是长度单位。面积数的是正方形，要写 cm²。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count the squares again and check the unit.
fallback.zh: 还没对。再数一遍格子，也看看单位。

reveal.en: The card is covered by 3 rows of 4 squares of 1 cm²: 12 cm².
reveal.zh: 卡片上有 3 行、每行 4 个 1 cm² 的正方形：12 cm²。

prompt.en: Cover the shape, then write its area and choose the unit. Each whole square is 1 cm².
prompt.zh: 铺满图形，再写面积并选单位。每个整格是 1 cm²。

guide.en: Count the whole squares and look at the two half squares at the sides. Pair the halves to make a whole square, then choose a square unit for the area.
guide.zh: 先数整格，再看两边的半格。两个半格合成一个整格，面积要用平方单位。

hints.en: Look at the two triangular pieces beside the whole squares.
hints.zh: 看看整格两边的两个三角形半格。

hints.en: Count each whole square once. The two half squares together count as one more.
hints.zh: 每个整格数一次，两个半格合起来再数一格。

hints.en: You have 8 whole squares and one pair of halves. Add the pair and choose cm².
hints.zh: 有 8 个整格和一对半格。再加上这对半格合成的 1 格，单位选 cm²。

correct.en: Yes. 8 whole squares and two halves cover the shape, so its area is 9 cm².
correct.zh: 对。8 个整格加两个半格铺满图形，面积是 9 cm²。

say.en: You counted each half as a whole square. Look at the two triangles: together they make one square.
say.zh: 你把每个半格当成了整格。看看两个三角形，它们合起来才是一格。

say.en: Your count is 9, but cm measures length. Look at the unit square: its area is 1 cm², so choose cm².
say.zh: 你数出 9，可 cm 量的是长度。看看单位正方形，它的面积是 1 cm²，要选 cm²。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count all the whole squares, pair the two halves, and check the area unit.
fallback.zh: 还没对。数齐整格，把两个半格配成一对，再检查面积单位。

reveal.en: Count 4 squares in the top row and 4 in the bottom row. The two halves make one more square: 4 + 4 + 1 = 9 cm².
reveal.zh: 上行有 4 格，下行有 4 格。两个半格合成一格：4 + 4 + 1 = 9 cm²。

prompt.en: Cover the shape, including its half squares. Write the area and choose the unit.
prompt.zh: 铺满图形，别漏掉半格。写出面积并选单位。

guide.en: Work through the whole squares one row at a time. Pair the four half squares along the top and add their area to the whole squares.
guide.zh: 一行一行数整格。把上面的四个半格两两配对，再加上它们的面积。

hints.en: Look above the three rows of whole squares.
hints.zh: 看看三行整格上面的半格。

hints.en: Four half squares make two whole squares. Add these to your whole-square count.
hints.zh: 四个半格合成两个整格，把它们加到整格数里。

hints.en: The three rows contain 12 whole squares. Add two squares made by the halves, then choose cm².
hints.zh: 三行共有 12 个整格。再加上半格合成的两格，选 cm²。

correct.en: Yes. 12 whole squares and four halves cover 14 squares of 1 cm²: 14 cm².
correct.zh: 对。12 个整格加四个半格，共铺满 14 个 1 cm²，面积是 14 cm²。

say.en: You counted only the 12 whole squares. Look at the four half squares on top: they add two whole squares.
say.zh: 你只数了 12 个整格。看看上面的四个半格，它们还合成两格。

say.en: 14 is the square count, but cm is a length unit. Check the legend and choose cm² for area.
say.zh: 14 是格子数，可 cm 是长度单位。看看图例，面积要选 cm²。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count the whole rows, pair every half square, and choose the square unit.
fallback.zh: 还没对。数齐整行，把所有半格两两配对，再选平方单位。

reveal.en: The rows have 4 + 4 + 4 = 12 whole squares. Four halves make two more squares: 12 + 2 = 14 cm².
reveal.zh: 整格有 4 + 4 + 4 = 12 格。四个半格合成两格：12 + 2 = 14 cm²。

prompt.en: Cover this stepped shape. Count the squares, then write the area and choose the unit.
prompt.zh: 铺满这个阶梯形，数格子，再写面积并选单位。

guide.en: Count the whole squares in each row without counting the empty spaces. The two half squares on the left together cover one whole square.
guide.zh: 逐行数整格，空白处不数。左边两个半格合起来铺满一个整格。

hints.en: Look at where each row of the shape ends and at the two halves on the left.
hints.zh: 看看每行在哪里结束，还有左边的两个半格。

hints.en: Count 3, 3, 6 and 6 whole squares from top to bottom. Pair the two halves.
hints.zh: 从上往下数整格：3、3、6、6。再把两个半格配成一对。

hints.en: There are 18 whole squares. The paired halves add one square; choose cm².
hints.zh: 有 18 个整格。一对半格再加一格，选 cm²。

correct.en: Yes. 18 whole squares and a pair of halves cover the shape: 19 cm².
correct.zh: 对。18 个整格加一对半格铺满图形，面积是 19 cm²。

say.en: You counted both half squares as whole squares. Look at the left tip: its two halves together make just one square.
say.zh: 你把两个半格都当成了整格。看看左边尖角，两个半格合起来只有一格。

say.en: 19 counts squares covering the shape. cm measures a length; look at the 1 cm² square in the legend.
say.zh: 19 对了，可 cm 量的是长度。图形是用 1 cm² 的正方形铺的，单位要选 cm²。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count only the squares inside the shape, include the paired halves, and check the unit.
fallback.zh: 还没对。只数图形里的格子，加上配对的半格，再检查单位。

reveal.en: The whole rows contain 3 + 3 + 6 + 6 = 18 squares. The two halves make one more: 18 + 1 = 19 cm².
reveal.zh: 整格逐行有 3 + 3 + 6 + 6 = 18 格。两个半格合成一格：18 + 1 = 19 cm²。

prompt.en: Each square on this classroom floor plan is 1 m². Write the area and choose the unit.
prompt.zh: 教室地面示意图每格是 1 m²。写出面积并选单位。

guide.en: Count the squares covering the floor one row at a time. Each square has sides of 1 m, so its area is 1 m².
guide.zh: 一行一行数铺满地面的格子。每格边长是 1 m，面积是 1 m²。

hints.en: Look inside the floor outline and check the legend.
hints.zh: 看看地面轮廓里面的格子和图例。

hints.en: Count six squares in each row and include all four rows.
hints.zh: 每行数六格，四行都要数。

hints.en: The count reaches 24 squares. Choose the unit for squares with 1 m sides.
hints.zh: 一共 24 格。每格边长 1 m，面积单位是 m²。

correct.en: Yes. 24 squares of 1 m² cover the floor shown, giving an area of 24 m².
correct.zh: 对。24 个 1 m² 的正方形铺满图中的地面，面积是 24 m²。

say.en: 24 counts squares, but m measures length. Look at the unit square: it covers 1 m², so choose m².
say.zh: 24 对了，可 m 量的是长度。一格是 1 m²，面积要写 m²。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count the squares in all four rows and check the square unit in the legend.
fallback.zh: 还没对。数齐四行的格子，再看看图例里的平方单位。

reveal.en: Counting the four rows gives 6 + 6 + 6 + 6 = 24 squares. Each is 1 m², so the floor shown covers 24 m².
reveal.zh: 数四行得到 6 + 6 + 6 + 6 = 24 格。每格是 1 m²，图中的地面面积是 24 m²。

prompt.en: Each square in this HDB corridor sketch is 1 m². Count the squares and write the area with its unit.
prompt.zh: 组屋走廊示意图每格是 1 m²。数格子，写面积和单位。

guide.en: Follow each row inside the corridor outline and count only covered squares. Read the legend to choose the square unit for the total.
guide.zh: 沿走廊轮廓一行一行数，只数里面的格子。再看图例，选出平方单位。

hints.en: Look at the short rows above the bend and the longer rows below it.
hints.zh: 看看转角上面的短行和下面的长行。

hints.en: From top to bottom, count 2, 2, 6 and 6 squares.
hints.zh: 从上往下，每行数 2、2、6、6 格。

hints.en: There are 16 covered squares. Each square has an area of 1 m².
hints.zh: 铺满的格子共有 16 个，每个面积是 1 m²。

correct.en: Yes. 16 squares of 1 m² cover the corridor in the sketch: 16 m².
correct.zh: 对。16 个 1 m² 的正方形铺满示意图中的走廊，面积是 16 m²。

say.en: 16 is the count of covered squares. m measures length; look at the legend and use m² for area.
say.zh: 16 对了，可 m 量的是长度。图例里一格是 1 m²，面积要写 m²。

fallback.en: Not yet. Leave out the empty spaces, count the covered squares, and check the area unit.
fallback.zh: 还没对。空白处不数，数齐铺满的格子，再检查面积单位。

reveal.en: Count the covered rows: 2 + 2 + 6 + 6 = 16 squares. Each is 1 m², so the sketch shows an area of 16 m².
reveal.zh: 数铺满的各行：2 + 2 + 6 + 6 = 16 格。每格是 1 m²，图中面积是 16 m²。

prompt.en: Which unit suits the area of a stamp?
prompt.zh: 量一张邮票的面积，用哪个单位合适？

guide.en: A stamp is small: about as big as a few 1 cm squares side by side. Pick a square unit of a fitting size.
guide.zh: 邮票很小，只有几个 1 cm 的正方形那么大。选一个大小合适的平方单位。

hints.en: Could a 1 m square fit on a stamp?
hints.zh: 邮票上放得下一个 1 m 的正方形吗？

hints.en: Area needs a square unit with the small 2.
hints.zh: 面积的单位右上角有个小 2。

correct.en: Yes. Squares with 1 cm sides fit on a stamp, so its area is measured in cm².
correct.zh: 对。边长 1 cm 的正方形能铺在邮票上，所以邮票的面积用 cm² 来量。

say.en: cm measures a length, such as the side of the stamp. Area counts squares: choose a square unit.
say.zh: cm 量的是长度，比如邮票的一条边。面积数的是正方形：要选平方单位。

fallback.en: Not yet. Think how big a 1 m square is: much bigger than a stamp.
fallback.zh: 还没对。想想边长 1 m 的正方形有多大：比邮票大得多。

reveal.en: A stamp is covered by a few 1 cm squares: cm². A 1 m square is far bigger than the stamp, and cm is a length.
reveal.zh: 邮票用几个 1 cm 的正方形就铺满了：用 cm²。1 m 的正方形比邮票大得多，cm 则是长度单位。

prompt.en: Which unit suits the area of a classroom floor?
prompt.zh: 量教室地面的面积，用哪个单位合适？

guide.en: A classroom floor is big. Squares with 1 m sides cover it in a sensible number; 1 cm squares would take a very long time to count.
guide.zh: 教室地面很大。用边长 1 m 的正方形来铺，块数不多；用 1 cm 的正方形，要数到很久很久。

hints.en: Picture 1 m squares on the floor, like big floor tiles.
hints.zh: 想象地上铺着边长 1 m 的大地砖。

hints.en: Area needs a square unit with the small 2.
hints.zh: 面积的单位右上角有个小 2。

correct.en: Yes. Big surfaces like a floor are measured in square metres, m².
correct.zh: 对。教室地面这么大，用平方米（m²）来量。

say.en: m measures a length, such as the side of the room. Area counts squares: choose a square unit.
say.zh: m 量的是长度，比如教室的一条边。面积数的是正方形：要选平方单位。

fallback.en: Not yet. Think about how many 1 cm squares a whole floor would take.
fallback.zh: 还没对。想想铺满整个地面要多少块 1 cm 的正方形。

reveal.en: A classroom floor takes a few dozen 1 m squares: m². 1 cm squares would be far too small, and m is a length.
reveal.zh: 教室地面要几十块 1 m 的正方形：用 m²。1 cm 的正方形太小了，m 则是长度单位。

prompt.en: Which unit suits the area of an HDB corridor floor?
prompt.zh: 量组屋走廊地面的面积，用哪个单位合适？

guide.en: A corridor floor is long and wide enough to walk on. Choose squares that suit a floor.
guide.zh: 走廊地面很大。选一个大小适合量地面的正方形。

hints.en: Would you measure a floor with stamp-sized squares?
hints.zh: 你会用邮票那么大的正方形去量地面吗？

hints.en: Area needs a square unit with the small 2.
hints.zh: 面积的单位右上角有个小 2。

correct.en: Yes. A corridor floor is measured in square metres, m².
correct.zh: 对。走廊地面用平方米 m² 来量。

say.en: m measures a length, such as how long the corridor is. Area counts squares: choose a square unit.
say.zh: m 量的是长度，比如走廊有多长。面积数的是正方形：要选平方单位。

fallback.en: Not yet. Think about the size of the floor and of the squares.
fallback.zh: 还没对。想想地面有多大，正方形又有多大。

reveal.en: A floor is covered by 1 m squares: m². 1 cm squares are far too small for it, and m is a length.
reveal.zh: 地面用 1 m 的正方形来铺：用 m²。1 cm 的正方形太小了，m 则是长度单位。

caption.en: Perimeter is the distance all the way round the edge of a shape.
caption.zh: 周长是沿着图形的边走一圈的长度。

caption.en: Walk round the edge one square side at a time: 1, 2, 3 … You are back at the start after 14 steps. The perimeter is 14 cm.
caption.zh: 沿着边一小段一小段地走：1、2、3……走 14 段回到起点。周长是 14 cm。

caption.en: Counting the squares along the edge gives 10, not 14. Each corner square has two sides on the edge. Count the sides, not the squares.
caption.zh: 数边上的格子只有 10 个，不是 14。角上的格子有两条边在外面。要数边，不数格子。

caption.en: Area counts the squares inside; perimeter counts the lengths around. One shape, two measures, two units.
caption.zh: 面积数里面的正方形，周长量外面一圈的长度。同一个图形，两种量法，两种单位。

keyFacts.en: Perimeter is the distance around a shape.
keyFacts.zh: 周长是绕图形一圈的长度。

keyFacts.en: Count the sides of the squares along the edge, not the squares.
keyFacts.zh: 数边上的线段，不数格子。

prompt.en: Trace every side round the card, then write its perimeter.
prompt.zh: 描出卡片外面一圈的每一段，再写出它的周长。

guide.en: Tap the sides of the squares along the outside edge, all the way round. Each side is 1 cm. Inside lines are not part of the perimeter.
guide.zh: 沿着外边，把每个小格露在外面的边都点一遍，走完一整圈。每段 1 cm。里面的线不算周长。

hints.en: Start at a corner and go round.
hints.zh: 从一个角开始，绕着走。

hints.en: A corner square has two sides on the edge.
hints.zh: 角上的格子有两条边在外面。

correct.en: Yes. 16 sides of 1 cm go round the card: the perimeter is 16 cm.
correct.zh: 对。绕卡片一圈有 16 段，每段 1 cm：周长是 16 cm。

say.en: 12 is the number of squares along the edge. Count the sides on the edge instead: a corner square has two.
say.zh: 12 是边上的格子数。要数外面的线段：角上的格子有两段。

say.en: 15 counts the squares inside: that is the area. The perimeter is the distance round the edge.
say.zh: 15 是里面的格子数，那是面积。周长是绕边一圈的长度。

fallback.en: Not yet. Walk round the edge again and count every side once.
fallback.zh: 还没对。沿着边再走一圈，每一段数一次。

reveal.en: Along the top 5, down 3, back 5, up 3: 16 sides, 16 cm.
reveal.zh: 上边 5 段，右边 3 段，下边 5 段，左边 3 段：16 段，16 cm。

prompt.en: Trace every small side round the bookmark, then write its perimeter.
prompt.zh: 描出书签外面一圈的每一小段，再写周长。

guide.en: Begin at a corner and tap each small side along the outside. Each small side is 1 cm; keep going until you return to the start.
guide.zh: 从一个角开始，沿着外边点出每一小段。每段长 1 cm，绕一圈回到起点。

hints.en: Look at the outside edge of the bookmark.
hints.zh: 先看书签外面一圈的边。

hints.en: At a corner, count both exposed sides of the corner square.
hints.zh: 到角上时，格子露在外面的两段都要数。

hints.en: Count 7 along the top, 3 down, 7 back and 3 up.
hints.zh: 上边数 7 段，向下 3 段，往回 7 段，向上 3 段。

correct.en: Yes. 20 small sides of 1 cm go round the bookmark, so its perimeter is 20 cm.
correct.zh: 对。绕书签一圈有 20 段，每段长 1 cm，周长是 20 cm。

say.en: 16 counts the squares along the edge. Look at a corner square: both its outside sides belong to the perimeter.
say.zh: 16 是边上的格子数。看看角上的格子，它露在外面的两段都算周长。

say.en: Inside squares measure area, and a line shared by two squares is inside too. Count only the sides round the bookmark.
say.zh: 数里面的格子得到的是面积。格子之间共用的线在里面，不算周长；只数绕书签一圈的外边。

fallback.en: Not yet. Follow the outside edge once more, counting each small side once.
fallback.zh: 还没对。再沿外边走一圈，每一小段只数一次。

reveal.en: Going round from the top gives 7 + 3 + 7 + 3 = 20 small sides. Each is 1 cm, so the perimeter is 20 cm.
reveal.zh: 从上边开始绕一圈：7 + 3 + 7 + 3 = 20 段。每段长 1 cm，周长是 20 cm。

prompt.en: Trace the outside of the square label, then write the perimeter.
prompt.zh: 描出正方形标签外面一圈的边，再写周长。

guide.en: Tap the small sides that go round the label. A line between two squares is inside the label, so leave it out.
guide.zh: 点出绕标签一圈的每一小段。两个格子之间的线在标签里面，不算在这一圈里。

hints.en: Find the four corners of the label.
hints.zh: 先找到标签的四个角。

hints.en: Count small sides rather than the squares touching the edge.
hints.zh: 数外边的小线段，不数贴着边的格子。

hints.en: There are 3 small sides along each of the four edges.
hints.zh: 四条边上各有 3 小段。

correct.en: Yes. You counted 12 small sides round the label. Each is 1 cm, so the perimeter is 12 cm.
correct.zh: 对。绕标签一圈数到 12 小段，每段长 1 cm，周长是 12 cm。

say.en: 8 counts the squares touching the edge. Each corner square contributes two outside sides; count those sides.
say.zh: 8 是贴着边的格子数。角上的格子各有两段在外面，要数这两段。

say.en: The inside squares measure area; the line between two squares is also inside. Keep your count and trace on the outside edge.
say.zh: 数里面的格子得到的是面积。格子之间的线在里面，不算周长；描边和数周长，都只沿外边绕一圈。

fallback.en: Not yet. Go from corner to corner round the label and count every small side.
fallback.zh: 还没对。沿标签外边从一个角走到下一个角，数齐每一小段。

reveal.en: Count 3 small sides on the top, right, bottom and left: 3 + 3 + 3 + 3 = 12. The perimeter is 12 cm.
reveal.zh: 上、右、下、左各数 3 小段：3 + 3 + 3 + 3 = 12。周长是 12 cm。

prompt.en: Trace all the small sides round the L shape, then write its perimeter.
prompt.zh: 描出 L 形外面一圈的每一小段，再写周长。

guide.en: Follow the edge of the L shape through every turn. Each small side is 1 unit long; the sides beside the empty corner are part of the route.
guide.zh: 沿 L 形的边走，遇到转弯也跟着走。每小段长 1 个单位，缺角旁边的边也在这一圈里。

hints.en: Look at where the shape meets the empty grid.
hints.zh: 看看图形和空白方格交界的地方。

hints.en: Turn along the edge beside the empty corner, then continue round.
hints.zh: 沿着缺角旁边的边转弯，再接着绕一圈。

hints.en: From the bottom-left, count 4, 2, 2, 2, 2 and 4 small sides.
hints.zh: 从左下角开始，依次数 4、2、2、2、2、4 小段。

correct.en: Yes. 16 small sides go round the L shape. Each is 1 unit long, so its perimeter is 16 units.
correct.zh: 对。绕 L 形一圈有 16 小段，每段长 1 个单位，周长是 16 个单位长。

say.en: 11 counts squares touching the boundary. A square can have more than one exposed side; count each exposed side.
say.zh: 11 是贴着边的格子数。一个格子可能露出不止一段，每一段都要数。

say.en: Squares covering the L shape measure area. Lines with a square on both sides are inside; trace only where the shape meets empty grid.
say.zh: 数铺满 L 形的格子得到的是面积。两边都有格子的线在 L 形里面，只描 L 形和空白方格交界的边。

fallback.en: Not yet. Follow every turn in the outline and count only the exposed small sides.
fallback.zh: 还没对。跟着轮廓的每个转弯走，只数露在外面的每一小段。

reveal.en: Following the six straight edges gives 4 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 4 = 16 small sides. The perimeter is 16 units.
reveal.zh: 沿六条直边数：4 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 4 = 16 小段。周长是 16 个单位长。

prompt.en: Trace the edge of the step-shaped figure, then write its perimeter.
prompt.zh: 描出阶梯形图形外面一圈的边，再写周长。

guide.en: Keep your trace between the figure and the empty grid, including the two sides at the step. Count each small side as 1 cm.
guide.zh: 沿图形和空白方格交界的边描一圈，台阶处的两条边也要描。每小段算 1 cm。

hints.en: Find the short edges at the step.
hints.zh: 先找到台阶处的短边。

hints.en: Count each small side as you go round; do not cut across the figure.
hints.zh: 绕一圈时逐段数，不从图形里面穿过去。

hints.en: Starting along the bottom, count 5, 2, 2, 2, 3 and 4 small sides.
hints.zh: 从下边开始，依次数 5、2、2、2、3、4 小段。

correct.en: Yes. The route round the figure has 18 small sides of 1 cm, so the perimeter is 18 cm.
correct.zh: 对。绕图形一圈有 18 小段，每段长 1 cm，周长是 18 cm。

say.en: 13 counts the squares along the edge. Look at the exposed sides of each square and count each side separately.
say.zh: 13 是边上的格子数。看看每个格子露在外面的边，每一小段分别数。

say.en: The squares covering the figure measure area, and their shared lines lie inside. Follow only the exposed sides all the way round.
say.zh: 数铺满图形的格子得到的是面积。格子之间共用的格线在里面，不算周长；只沿露在外面的边绕一圈。

fallback.en: Not yet. Check the step and the corners, counting every outside small side once.
fallback.zh: 还没对。检查台阶和各个角，外面的每一小段都数一次。

reveal.en: Round the edge you count 5 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 3 + 4 = 18 small sides. Each is 1 cm, giving a perimeter of 18 cm.
reveal.zh: 沿边绕一圈数到 5 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 3 + 4 = 18 小段。每段长 1 cm，周长是 18 cm。

prompt.en: Count the small sides round the paper strip. What is its perimeter?
prompt.zh: 数纸条外面一圈的小线段。周长是多少？

guide.en: Imagine walking round the strip without crossing the inside. Count every small side on your route as 1 cm.
guide.zh: 想象沿纸条外边走一圈，不穿过里面。路上的每一小段都数作 1 cm。

hints.en: Start at the top-left corner.
hints.zh: 从左上角开始。

hints.en: Continue past every corner until you reach the start again.
hints.zh: 走过每个角，直到回到起点。

hints.en: Count 8 along the top, 3 down, 8 back and 3 up.
hints.zh: 上边数 8 段，向下 3 段，往回 8 段，向上 3 段。

correct.en: Yes. 22 small sides of 1 cm go round the strip, so the perimeter is 22 cm.
correct.zh: 对。绕纸条一圈有 22 小段，每段长 1 cm，周长是 22 cm。

say.en: 24 counts the squares that cover the strip. Look at the outside edge and count its small sides.
say.zh: 24 是铺满纸条的格子数。看看外面一圈的边，数那里的小线段。

say.en: 18 counts border squares. At each corner, the square has two exposed sides; count both.
say.zh: 18 是边上的格子数。每个角上的格子有两段露在外面，两段都要数。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count the small sides all the way round the strip.
fallback.zh: 还没对。沿纸条外边走完整圈，数齐每一小段。

reveal.en: The four stretches contain 8 + 3 + 8 + 3 = 22 small sides. Each is 1 cm, so the perimeter is 22 cm.
reveal.zh: 四条边依次数到 8 + 3 + 8 + 3 = 22 小段。每段长 1 cm，周长是 22 cm。

prompt.en: What is the perimeter of this rectangle in units?
prompt.zh: 这个长方形的周长是多少个单位长？

guide.en: Each small side on the grid is 1 unit long. Follow the rectangle all the way round and count the small sides on its edge.
guide.zh: 方格上每一小段长 1 个单位。沿长方形的边绕一圈，数外边的小线段。

hints.en: Look at the outline rather than the inside squares.
hints.zh: 看看外面一圈的边。

hints.en: Count both outside sides of a corner square.
hints.zh: 角上的格子露在外面的两段都要数。

hints.en: You pass stretches of 5, 4, 5 and 4 small sides.
hints.zh: 一圈依次经过 5、4、5、4 小段。

correct.en: Yes. There are 18 small sides round the rectangle, so its perimeter is 18 units.
correct.zh: 对。绕长方形一圈有 18 小段，周长是 18 个单位长。

say.en: 14 counts squares touching the edge. Count the exposed sides, including both sides at each corner.
say.zh: 14 是贴着边的格子数。要数露在外面的线段，每个角上的两段都要数。

say.en: 20 squares cover the inside; that is the area. Count the unit sides round the rectangle for perimeter.
say.zh: 20 个格子铺满里面，那是面积。求周长要数长方形外面一圈的单位线段。

fallback.en: Not yet. Go round all four edges and count each small side once.
fallback.zh: 还没对。沿四条边绕一圈，每一小段只数一次。

reveal.en: Counting round gives 5 + 4 + 5 + 4 = 18 small sides. Each is 1 unit long, so the perimeter is 18 units.
reveal.zh: 绕一圈数到 5 + 4 + 5 + 4 = 18 小段。每段长 1 个单位，周长是 18 个单位长。

prompt.en: Count round this stamp on the grid. What is its perimeter?
prompt.zh: 沿方格上的邮票绕一圈。周长是多少？

guide.en: Count the small sides round the stamp, with each side measuring 1 cm. At a corner, turn and keep counting until you are back at the start.
guide.zh: 沿邮票外边数小线段，每段长 1 cm。到角上就转弯，继续数到回到起点。

hints.en: Follow the edge where the stamp meets empty grid.
hints.zh: 沿邮票和空白方格交界的边走。

hints.en: A corner square has two small sides on your route.
hints.zh: 角上的格子有两段在这一圈里。

hints.en: Across the top is 3 small sides; continue 2, 3 and 2.
hints.zh: 上边有 3 小段，再依次数 2、3、2 小段。

correct.en: Yes. You pass 10 small sides of 1 cm on a full round, so the perimeter is 10 cm.
correct.zh: 对。走完整圈经过 10 小段，每段长 1 cm，周长是 10 cm。

say.en: 6 counts the squares covering the stamp. To find perimeter, look at the small sides round its edge.
say.zh: 6 是铺满邮票的格子数。求周长要看外面一圈的小线段。

fallback.en: Not yet. Start at a corner and count every small side round the stamp.
fallback.zh: 还没对。从一个角开始，数齐邮票外面一圈的每一小段。

reveal.en: Round the stamp you count 3 + 2 + 3 + 2 = 10 small sides. Each is 1 cm, so its perimeter is 10 cm.
reveal.zh: 绕邮票一圈数到 3 + 2 + 3 + 2 = 10 小段。每段长 1 cm，周长是 10 cm。

prompt.en: Which description tells you how to measure this shape’s perimeter?
prompt.zh: 哪一种说法说的是怎样求这个图形的周长？

guide.en: Think of a path that goes round the shape and returns to its start. Decide which description follows that path.
guide.zh: 想象沿图形的边绕一圈，回到起点。选出描述这条路线的说法。

text.en: Count the squares that cover the inside of the shape.
text.zh: 数铺满图形里面的正方形。

text.en: Count every small side all the way round the outside edge.
text.zh: 数图形外面一圈的每一小段。

text.en: Count each square touching the outside edge once.
text.zh: 数贴着外边的格子，每个格子数一次。

hints.en: Look at the edge between the shape and empty grid.
hints.zh: 看看图形和空白方格交界的边。

hints.en: Perimeter measures a route round the shape.
hints.zh: 周长就是绕图形一圈的长度。

correct.en: Yes. The small sides round the outside measure the distance round the shape: its perimeter.
correct.zh: 对。数外面一圈的小线段，得到的是绕图形一圈的长度，也就是周长。

say.en: Squares covering the inside measure area. Look for the description that follows the outside edge.
say.zh: 数铺满里面的正方形，得到的是面积。找一找沿外边绕一圈的说法。

say.en: A square at a corner has two sides on the edge. Count those sides, rather than counting that square once.
say.zh: 角上的格子有两段在外边，两段都要数，不能只当一段。

fallback.en: Not yet. Imagine walking along the edge without entering the shape.
fallback.zh: 还没对。想象沿图形的边走一圈，不走进里面。

reveal.en: Choose "Count every small side all the way round the outside edge." Each small side is 1 cm of the perimeter.
reveal.zh: 选“数图形外面一圈的每一小段”。每小段长 1 cm，加起来就是周长。

caption.en: Without a grid, use the side lengths. Add all four sides: 5 + 3 + 5 + 3 = 16 cm.
caption.zh: 没有方格时，就用边长。把四条边加起来：5 + 3 + 5 + 3 = 16 cm。

caption.en: Opposite sides of a rectangle are equal, so there are two lengths of 5 cm and two breadths of 3 cm.
caption.zh: 长方形的对边一样长：两条长各 5 cm，两条宽各 3 cm。

caption.en: 5 + 3 takes you only halfway round. Keep walking: the other half is another 8 cm.
caption.zh: 5 + 3 只走到一半。接着走，另一半还有 8 cm。

caption.en: A square has four equal sides, so its perimeter is 4 × side: 4 × 4 = 16 cm.
caption.zh: 正方形四条边一样长，周长 = 4 × 边长：4 × 4 = 16 cm。

keyFacts.en: Perimeter of a rectangle: add the four sides, two lengths and two breadths.
keyFacts.zh: 长方形的周长：两条长加两条宽。

keyFacts.en: Perimeter of a square = 4 × side.
keyFacts.zh: 正方形的周长 = 4 × 边长。

prompt.en: A rectangle is 8 cm long and 5 cm wide. What is its perimeter?
prompt.zh: 一个长方形长 8 cm，宽 5 cm。它的周长是多少？

guide.en: A rectangle has two lengths and two breadths. Add all four sides, or find 2 × length + 2 × breadth.
guide.zh: 长方形有两条长、两条宽。把四条边加起来，或者算 2 × 长 + 2 × 宽。

hints.en: How many sides does a rectangle have?
hints.zh: 长方形有几条边？

hints.en: Opposite sides are equal: 8, 5, 8, 5.

correct.en: Yes. 8 + 5 + 8 + 5 = 26: the perimeter is 26 cm.

say.en: 8 + 5 is only one length and one breadth: half the way round. Add the other two sides too.
say.zh: 8 + 5 只是一条长和一条宽，只走了半圈。另外两条边也要加上。

say.en: 8 × 5 = 40 finds the area. The perimeter adds the sides round the edge.
say.zh: 8 × 5 = 40 算的是面积。周长是把外面一圈的边加起来。

fallback.en: Not yet. Add all four sides of the rectangle.
fallback.zh: 还没对。把长方形的四条边都加起来。

reveal.en: Two lengths of 8 cm and two breadths of 5 cm: 16 + 10 = 26 cm.
reveal.zh: 两条 8 cm 的长，两条 5 cm 的宽：16 + 10 = 26 cm。

prompt.en: Find the perimeter of this rectangle with length 9 cm and breadth 4 cm.
prompt.zh: 这个长方形长 9 cm，宽 4 cm。求它的周长。

guide.en: Use the labels, as the drawing is not to scale. Follow the edge round and add all four sides.
guide.zh: 图形未按比例画，要用标出的边长。沿边绕一圈，把四条边加起来。

hints.en: Look at the top and left side labels.
hints.zh: 看看上边和左边标出的长度。

hints.en: The bottom has the same length as the top; the right side has the same breadth as the left.
hints.zh: 下边和上边一样长，右边和左边一样长。

correct.en: Yes. Two lengths of 9 cm and two breadths of 4 cm go round the rectangle: 26 cm.
correct.zh: 对。两条 9 cm 的长和两条 4 cm 的宽，绕一圈共 26 cm。

say.en: 9 + 4 adds only one length and one breadth. Look at the opposite sides and include them too.
say.zh: 9 + 4 只加了一条长和一条宽。看看对边，把另外两条边也加上。

say.en: 9 × 4 = 36 finds the area the rectangle covers. Look round the edge and add two lengths and two breadths.
say.zh: 9 × 4 = 36 算的是长方形铺满的面积。看看外面一圈，把两条长、两条宽加起来。

fallback.en: Not yet. Follow the labelled lengths all the way round and include every side.
fallback.zh: 还没对。用标出的边长绕一圈，把每条边都加上。

reveal.en: The opposite sides are equal. Add 9 + 4 + 9 + 4 = 26 cm, so the perimeter is 26 cm.
reveal.zh: 对边一样长。9 + 4 + 9 + 4 = 26 cm，所以周长是 26 cm。

prompt.en: A rectangle has length 14 cm and breadth 6 cm. What is its perimeter?
prompt.zh: 长方形长 14 cm，宽 6 cm。周长是多少？

guide.en: You have two lengths and two breadths to include. Add each pair, then add the two totals.
guide.zh: 要把两条长、两条宽都算进去。先分别相加，再把两部分合起来。

hints.en: Follow the edge back to your starting point.
hints.zh: 沿边走一圈，回到起点。

hints.en: Both lengths are 14 cm and both breadths are 6 cm.
hints.zh: 两条长都是 14 cm，两条宽都是 6 cm。

hints.en: Add 14 + 14, then 6 + 6, and combine the totals.
hints.zh: 先算 14 + 14 和 6 + 6，再把它们加起来。

correct.en: Yes. Two lengths of 14 cm and two breadths of 6 cm go round the rectangle: 40 cm.
correct.zh: 对。两条 14 cm 的长和两条 6 cm 的宽，绕一圈共 40 cm。

say.en: 14 + 6 adds only one length and one breadth. Look at the opposite sides and include them too.
say.zh: 14 + 6 只加了一条长和一条宽。看看对边，把另外两条边也加上。

say.en: 14 × 6 = 84 finds the area the rectangle covers. Look round the edge and add two lengths and two breadths.
say.zh: 14 × 6 = 84 算的是长方形铺满的面积。看看外面一圈，把两条长、两条宽加起来。

fallback.en: Not yet. Follow the labelled lengths all the way round and include every side.
fallback.zh: 还没对。用标出的边长绕一圈，把每条边都加上。

reveal.en: The opposite sides are equal. Add 14 + 6 + 14 + 6 = 40 cm, so the perimeter is 40 cm.
reveal.zh: 对边一样长。14 + 6 + 14 + 6 = 40 cm，所以周长是 40 cm。

prompt.en: Each side of this square is 7 cm. What is its perimeter?
prompt.zh: 正方形的边长是 7 cm。周长是多少？

guide.en: A square has four equal sides. Use the labelled side for each side as you go round.
guide.zh: 正方形四条边一样长。绕一圈时，每条边都用标出的边长来算。

hints.en: The label gives the length of one side.
hints.zh: 标出的数是一条边的长度。

hints.en: All four sides are 7 cm long.
hints.zh: 四条边都是 7 cm。

correct.en: Yes. All four sides are 7 cm, so the perimeter is 28 cm.
correct.zh: 对。四条边都是 7 cm，绕一圈的周长是 28 cm。

say.en: 7 + 7 adds only two sides, so it takes you halfway round. Add the other two equal sides too.
say.zh: 7 + 7 只加了两条边，走了半圈。另两条一样长的边也要加上。

say.en: 7 × 7 = 49 finds the area the square covers. To find the perimeter, add all four equal sides round the edge.
say.zh: 7 × 7 = 49 算的是正方形铺满的面积。周长要把外面一圈的四条边加起来。

fallback.en: Not yet. Follow the labelled lengths all the way round and include every side.
fallback.zh: 还没对。用标出的边长绕一圈，把每条边都加上。

reveal.en: Add the four equal sides: 7 + 7 + 7 + 7 = 28 cm. The perimeter is 28 cm.
reveal.zh: 把四条一样长的边加起来：7 + 7 + 7 + 7 = 28 cm。周长是 28 cm。

prompt.en: A rectangle has length 30 m and breadth 12 m. Find its perimeter.
prompt.zh: 长方形长 30 m，宽 12 m。求周长。

guide.en: You need the distance round all four sides. Use metres for the lengths and keep the total in metres.
guide.zh: 要算沿四条边绕一圈的长度。边长用米，周长也用米。

hints.en: Read the side lengths in metres.
hints.zh: 读一读以米为单位的边长。

hints.en: There are two lengths of 30 m and two breadths of 12 m.
hints.zh: 有两条 30 m 的长和两条 12 m 的宽。

correct.en: Yes. Two lengths of 30 m and two breadths of 12 m go round the rectangle: 84 m.
correct.zh: 对。两条 30 m 的长和两条 12 m 的宽，绕一圈共 84 m。

say.en: 30 + 12 adds only one length and one breadth. Look at the opposite sides and include them too.
say.zh: 30 + 12 只加了一条长和一条宽。看看对边，把另外两条边也加上。

say.en: 30 × 12 = 360 finds the area the rectangle covers. Look round the edge and add two lengths and two breadths.
say.zh: 30 × 12 = 360 算的是长方形铺满的面积。看看外面一圈，把两条长、两条宽加起来。

fallback.en: Not yet. Follow the labelled lengths all the way round and include every side.
fallback.zh: 还没对。用标出的边长绕一圈，把每条边都加上。

reveal.en: The opposite sides are equal. Add 30 + 12 + 30 + 12 = 84 m, so the perimeter is 84 m.

prompt.en: The square has a side of 9 m. Find the distance all the way round it.
prompt.zh: 正方形的边长是 9 m。绕一圈有多长？

guide.en: Follow all four edges of the square. Every edge has the labelled side length, so add that length four times.
guide.zh: 沿正方形的四条边绕一圈。每条边都和标出的边一样长，把这个边长加四次。

hints.en: Look at the side labelled 9 m.
hints.zh: 看看标着 9 m 的那条边。

hints.en: The other three sides are also 9 m.
hints.zh: 另外三条边也是 9 m。

hints.en: Start with 9 + 9, then add two more sides of 9 m.
hints.zh: 先算 9 + 9，再加上另外两条 9 m 的边。

correct.en: Yes. All four sides are 9 m, so the perimeter is 36 m.
correct.zh: 对。四条边都是 9 m，绕一圈的周长是 36 m。

say.en: 9 + 9 adds only two sides, so it takes you halfway round. Add the other two equal sides too.
say.zh: 9 + 9 只加了两条边，走了半圈。另两条一样长的边也要加上。

say.en: 9 × 9 = 81 finds the area the square covers. To find the perimeter, add all four equal sides round the edge.
say.zh: 9 × 9 = 81 算的是正方形铺满的面积。周长要把外面一圈的四条边加起来。

fallback.en: Not yet. Follow the labelled lengths all the way round and include every side.
fallback.zh: 还没对。用标出的边长绕一圈，把每条边都加上。

reveal.en: Add the four equal sides: 9 + 9 + 9 + 9 = 36 m. The perimeter is 36 m.
reveal.zh: 把四条一样长的边加起来：9 + 9 + 9 + 9 = 36 m。周长是 36 m。

prompt.en: You put a border all round a notice board with length 48 cm and breadth 32 cm. How many cm of border do you need?
prompt.zh: 告示板长 48 cm，宽 32 cm。围一圈边框要多少厘米？

guide.en: The border goes round the edge of the rectangular board. Include two lengths and two breadths.
guide.zh: 边框沿长方形告示板的边绕一圈。两条长、两条宽都要算进去。

hints.en: Think about the four edges the border follows.
hints.zh: 想一想边框要沿着哪四条边。

hints.en: The top and bottom are each 48 cm; the left and right are each 32 cm.
hints.zh: 上、下两边各是 48 cm，左、右两边各是 32 cm。

hints.en: Add 48 + 32 + 48 + 32 to find the border length.
hints.zh: 把 48 + 32 + 48 + 32 加起来，求边框的总长度。

correct.en: Yes. Two lengths of 48 cm and two breadths of 32 cm go round the rectangle: 160 cm.
correct.zh: 对。两条 48 cm 的长和两条 32 cm 的宽，绕一圈共 160 cm。

say.en: 48 + 32 adds only one length and one breadth. Look at the opposite sides and include them too.
say.zh: 48 + 32 只加了一条长和一条宽。看看对边，把另外两条边也加上。

say.en: 48 × 32 = 1536 finds the area the rectangle covers. Look round the edge and add two lengths and two breadths.
say.zh: 48 × 32 = 1536 算的是长方形铺满的面积。看看外面一圈，把两条长、两条宽加起来。

fallback.en: Not yet. Follow the labelled lengths all the way round and include every side.
fallback.zh: 还没对。用标出的边长绕一圈，把每条边都加上。

reveal.en: The opposite sides are equal. Add 48 + 32 + 48 + 32 = 160 cm, so the perimeter is 160 cm.
reveal.zh: 对边一样长。48 + 32 + 48 + 32 = 160 cm，所以周长是 160 cm。

prompt.en: You fence all round a rectangular garden with length 24 m and breadth 15 m. How many metres of fence do you need?
prompt.zh: 花园长 24 m，宽 15 m。用围栏围一圈要多少米？

guide.en: The fence follows the whole edge of the garden. Add all four side lengths to find how much fence you need.
guide.zh: 围栏沿花园的边围一整圈。把四条边的长度加起来，就知道要多少米围栏。

hints.en: Follow the fence round the whole garden.
hints.zh: 沿围栏绕整个花园走一圈。

hints.en: Use 24 m for each length and 15 m for each breadth.
hints.zh: 两条长各用 24 m，两条宽各用 15 m。

correct.en: Yes. Two lengths of 24 m and two breadths of 15 m go round the rectangle: 78 m.
correct.zh: 对。两条 24 m 的长和两条 15 m 的宽，绕一圈共 78 m。

say.en: 24 + 15 adds only one length and one breadth. Look at the opposite sides and include them too.
say.zh: 24 + 15 只加了一条长和一条宽。看看对边，把另外两条边也加上。

say.en: 24 × 15 = 360 finds the area the rectangle covers. Look round the edge and add two lengths and two breadths.
say.zh: 24 × 15 = 360 算的是长方形铺满的面积。看看外面一圈，把两条长、两条宽加起来。

fallback.en: Not yet. Follow the labelled lengths all the way round and include every side.
fallback.zh: 还没对。用标出的边长绕一圈，把每条边都加上。

reveal.en: The opposite sides are equal. Add 24 + 15 + 24 + 15 = 78 m, so the perimeter is 78 m.

prompt.en: Which number sentence finds the perimeter of this rectangle with length 11 cm and breadth 7 cm?
prompt.zh: 长方形长 11 cm，宽 7 cm。哪个算式求周长？

guide.en: Check which sides each number sentence includes. You need two lengths and two breadths to go all the way round.
guide.zh: 看看每个算式算了哪些边。绕一整圈要算两条长、两条宽。

hints.en: Look at the pair of opposite lengths and the pair of opposite breadths.
hints.zh: 看看相对的两条长和相对的两条宽。

hints.en: One length plus one breadth takes you only halfway round.
hints.zh: 一条长加一条宽，只走了半圈。

hints.en: The sentence must include 11 twice and 7 twice.
hints.zh: 算式要把 11 和 7 都各算两次。

correct.en: Yes. This sentence includes both lengths and both breadths, so it finds the distance round all four sides.
correct.zh: 对。这个算式把两条长、两条宽都算上了，求的是沿四条边绕一圈的长度。

say.en: 11 × 7 finds the area the rectangle covers. To find the perimeter, look for a sentence that adds the lengths round all four sides.
say.zh: 11 × 7 算的是长方形铺满的面积。求周长，要找把外面四条边的长度加起来的算式。

say.en: 11 + 7 includes only one length and one breadth. Look for a sentence that includes the opposite sides as well.
say.zh: 11 + 7 只有一条长和一条宽。看看哪个算式把对边也算进去了。

fallback.en: Not yet. Match the numbers in each sentence to all four sides of the rectangle.
fallback.zh: 还没对。把每个算式中的数和长方形的四条边对照一下。

reveal.en: 2 × 11 + 2 × 7 includes two lengths and two breadths. It gives a perimeter of 36 cm.
reveal.zh: 2 × 11 + 2 × 7 把两条长、两条宽都加起来，周长是 36 cm。

prompt.en: Which number sentence finds the perimeter of this rectangle with length 18 m and breadth 8 m?
prompt.zh: 长方形长 18 m，宽 8 m。哪个算式求周长？

guide.en: Check which sides each number sentence includes. You need two lengths and two breadths to go all the way round.
guide.zh: 看看每个算式算了哪些边。绕一整圈要算两条长、两条宽。

hints.en: Look at the pair of opposite lengths and the pair of opposite breadths.
hints.zh: 看看相对的两条长和相对的两条宽。

hints.en: One length plus one breadth takes you only halfway round.
hints.zh: 一条长加一条宽，只走了半圈。

hints.en: The sentence must include 18 twice and 8 twice.
hints.zh: 算式要把 18 和 8 都各算两次。

correct.en: Yes. This sentence includes both lengths and both breadths, so it finds the distance round all four sides.
correct.zh: 对。这个算式把两条长、两条宽都算上了，求的是沿四条边绕一圈的长度。

say.en: 18 + 8 includes only one length and one breadth. Look for a sentence that includes the opposite sides as well.
say.zh: 18 + 8 只有一条长和一条宽。看看哪个算式把对边也算进去了。

say.en: 18 × 8 finds the area the rectangle covers. To find the perimeter, look for a sentence that adds the lengths round all four sides.
say.zh: 18 × 8 算的是长方形铺满的面积。求周长，要找把外面四条边的长度加起来的算式。

fallback.en: Not yet. Match the numbers in each sentence to all four sides of the rectangle.
fallback.zh: 还没对。把每个算式中的数和长方形的四条边对照一下。

reveal.en: (18 + 8) × 2 includes two lengths and two breadths. It gives a perimeter of 52 m.
reveal.zh: (18 + 8) × 2 把两条长、两条宽都加起来，周长是 52 m。

caption.en: A rectilinear figure has straight sides that meet at square corners, like this L shape.
caption.zh: 直线图形的边都是直线，角都是直角，像这个 L 形。

caption.en: Walk round it: there are 6 sides. Two of them have no length marked yet.
caption.zh: 沿边走一圈：一共 6 条边，有两条还没标长度。

caption.en: Find each missing side from the side opposite it. Across: 4 + ? = 7, so it is 3 cm. Up: 3 + ? = 5, so it is 2 cm.
caption.zh: 用对面的边求没标的边。横着看：4 + ? = 7，所以是 3 cm；竖着看：3 + ? = 5，所以是 2 cm。

caption.en: Altogether 24 cm. When a step is cut from a corner, the perimeter is the same as the rectangle around it: 2 × (7 + 5) = 24.
caption.zh: 一共 24 cm。从角上切掉一个台阶时，周长和外面那个长方形一样：2 × (7 + 5) = 24。

keyFacts.en: Find unmarked sides from the opposite sides.
keyFacts.zh: 没标的边，用对面的边求。

keyFacts.en: Walk all the way round, every side once.
keyFacts.zh: 走完一整圈，每条边算一次。

prompt.en: Find the perimeter of the L-shaped figure.
prompt.zh: 求这个 L 形图形的周长。

guide.en: The figure has 6 sides. Two have no length marked: find each from the side opposite it, then add all six.
guide.zh: 这个图形有 6 条边，其中两条没标长度。先用对面的边把它们求出来，再把六条边加起来。

hints.en: Count the sides: there are 6.
hints.zh: 数一数：一共 6 条边。

hints.en: The missing sides are 4 cm and 2 cm.
hints.zh: 没标的两条边是 4 cm 和 2 cm。

correct.en: Yes. 9 + 4 + 4 + 2 + 5 + 6 = 30: the perimeter is 30 cm.

say.en: 24 adds only the four marked sides. Two sides have no label yet: find them from the sides opposite.
say.zh: 24 只加了标出的四条边。还有两条没标的边，用对面的边求出来。

fallback.en: Not yet. Walk all the way round and add every side once.
fallback.zh: 还没对。走完一整圈，每条边加一次。

reveal.en: The missing sides are 9 − 5 = 4 cm and 6 − 4 = 2 cm, so 9 + 4 + 4 + 2 + 5 + 6 = 30 cm.

prompt.en: Find the perimeter of this L-shaped card.
prompt.zh: 求这张 L 形卡片的周长。

guide.en: Two sides have no length marked. Match the horizontal parts to the bottom side and the vertical parts to the left side, then add all six.
guide.zh: 有两条边没标长度。上面的横边合起来等于下边，竖边合起来等于左边；先求没标的边，再加六条边。

hints.en: Look at the two sides at the inward corner.
hints.zh: 看凹角处的两条边。

hints.en: Find 12 − 5 and 9 − 4, then add all six sides.
hints.zh: 先算 12 − 5 和 9 − 4，再加六条边。

correct.en: Yes. 12 + 4 + 7 + 5 + 5 + 9 = 42 cm: all 6 sides go round the figure.
correct.zh: 对。12 + 4 + 7 + 5 + 5 + 9 = 42 cm：绕一圈的 6 条边都算到了。

say.en: 30 adds only the labelled sides. Follow the boundary and use the opposite totals to find the unmarked sides.
say.zh: 30 只加了标出长度的边。沿边走一圈，用对面的总长度求出没标的边。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find the unmarked lengths, then follow the boundary and add every side once.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先求没标的边长，再沿边走一圈，每条边加一次。

reveal.en: The unmarked sides are 12 − 5 = 7 cm and 9 − 4 = 5 cm. Add all the sides: 12 + 4 + 7 + 5 + 5 + 9 = 42 cm.
reveal.zh: 没标的两条边是 12 − 5 = 7 cm 和 9 − 4 = 5 cm。把所有边长加起来：12 + 4 + 7 + 5 + 5 + 9 = 42 cm。

prompt.en: Find the length of fence needed to go round this garden.
prompt.zh: 绕这个花园一圈需要多长的围栏？

guide.en: Follow the six sides, including the turn at the lower-left corner. Find the two unmarked sides by subtracting the marked parts from the opposite totals.
guide.zh: 沿六条边走，包括左下方的转角。用对面的总长度减去已知部分，求出两条没标的边。

hints.en: The two short sides at the lower-left turn need lengths.
hints.zh: 左下方转角的两条短边还没标长度。

hints.en: The short sides are 4 m and 3 m. Include them in the sum.
hints.zh: 两条短边是 4 m 和 3 m，加周长时也要算进去。

correct.en: Yes. 10 + 8 + 14 + 5 + 4 + 3 = 44 m: all 6 sides go round the figure.

say.en: 37 adds only the labelled sides. Follow the boundary and use the opposite totals to find the unmarked sides.
say.zh: 37 只加了标出长度的边。沿边走一圈，用对面的总长度求出没标的边。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find the unmarked lengths, then follow the boundary and add every side once.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先求没标的边长，再沿边走一圈，每条边加一次。

reveal.en: The short sides are 14 − 10 = 4 m and 8 − 5 = 3 m. Add all the sides: 10 + 8 + 14 + 5 + 4 + 3 = 44 m.

prompt.en: Find the perimeter of this stepped figure.
prompt.zh: 求这个阶梯形图形的周长。

guide.en: There are eight sides. The three horizontal parts together match the bottom, and the three vertical parts together match the left side.
guide.zh: 一共有八条边。三段横边合起来等于下边，三段竖边合起来等于左边。

hints.en: Find the horizontal and vertical sides with no labels.
hints.zh: 找出没标长度的一条横边和一条竖边。

hints.en: Find 16 − 6 − 5 and 10 − 3 − 3, then add eight sides.

correct.en: Yes. 16 + 3 + 5 + 3 + 5 + 4 + 6 + 10 = 52 cm: all 8 sides go round the figure.

say.en: 43 adds only the labelled sides. Follow the boundary and use the opposite totals to find the unmarked sides.
say.zh: 43 只加了标出长度的边。沿边走一圈，用对面的总长度求出没标的边。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find the unmarked lengths, then follow the boundary and add every side once.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先求没标的边长，再沿边走一圈，每条边加一次。

reveal.en: The unmarked sides are 16 − 6 − 5 = 5 cm and 10 − 3 − 3 = 4 cm. Add all the sides: 16 + 3 + 5 + 3 + 5 + 4 + 6 + 10 = 52 cm.

prompt.en: Find the perimeter of this U-shaped figure.
prompt.zh: 求这个 U 形图形的周长。

guide.en: Follow the boundary down into the notch and back up. Use the labelled lengths to find the other top part and the unmarked vertical sides, then add all eight sides.
guide.zh: 沿边走进凹口，再走出来。用已知边长求出另一段上边和没标的竖边，再加八条边。

hints.en: The three sides of the notch are part of the boundary.
hints.zh: 凹口的三条边也在图形的边界上。

hints.en: The top parts and the notch base span 13 cm: ? + 5 + 4 = 13. Both notch sides have the same depth.
hints.zh: 两段上边和凹口底边合起来是 13 cm：? + 5 + 4 = 13。凹口两边一样深。

hints.en: The unmarked sides are 4 cm, 5 cm and 9 cm. Add all eight sides, including the notch.
hints.zh: 没标的边是 4 cm、5 cm 和 9 cm。把八条边都加起来，包括凹口。

correct.en: Yes. 13 + 9 + 4 + 5 + 5 + 5 + 4 + 9 = 54 cm: all 8 sides go round the figure.

say.en: 36 adds only the labelled sides. Follow the boundary and use the opposite totals to find the unmarked sides.
say.zh: 36 只加了标出长度的边。沿边走一圈，用对面的总长度求出没标的边。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find the unmarked lengths, then follow the boundary and add every side once.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先求没标的边长，再沿边走一圈，每条边加一次。

reveal.en: The other top part is 13 − 5 − 4 = 4 cm. The two notch sides are each 5 cm, and the two outer vertical sides are each 9 cm. Add all the sides: 13 + 9 + 4 + 5 + 5 + 5 + 4 + 9 = 54 cm.
reveal.zh: 另一段上边是 13 − 5 − 4 = 4 cm。凹口两条竖边各是 5 cm，两条外侧竖边各是 9 cm。把所有边长加起来：13 + 9 + 4 + 5 + 5 + 5 + 4 + 9 = 54 cm。

prompt.en: Find the perimeter of the figure with a notch on its right side.
prompt.zh: 求右边有凹口的图形的周长。

guide.en: Go into the notch as you follow the edge. Its vertical side completes the full height, and its two horizontal sides have the same length.
guide.zh: 沿边走时也要走进凹口。凹口的竖边与右边另外两段合起来等于总高度，两条横边一样长。

hints.en: There are eight sides, including three around the notch.
hints.zh: 一共有八条边，包括凹口的三条边。

hints.en: Use 3 + ? + 4 = 11 to find the vertical side of the notch.
hints.zh: 用 3 + ? + 4 = 11 求凹口的竖边。

hints.en: The top is 10 cm; the two unmarked notch sides are each 4 cm.
hints.zh: 上边是 10 cm；凹口两条没标的边各是 4 cm。

correct.en: Yes. 10 + 3 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 10 + 11 = 50 cm: all 8 sides go round the figure.

say.en: 32 adds only the labelled sides. Follow the boundary and use the opposite totals to find the unmarked sides.
say.zh: 32 只加了标出长度的边。沿边走一圈，用对面的总长度求出没标的边。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find the unmarked lengths, then follow the boundary and add every side once.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先求没标的边长，再沿边走一圈，每条边加一次。

reveal.en: The top is 10 cm. The notch height is 11 − 3 − 4 = 4 cm, and its upper horizontal side is 4 cm. Add all the sides: 10 + 3 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 10 + 11 = 50 cm.
reveal.zh: 上边是 10 cm。凹口的竖边是 11 − 3 − 4 = 4 cm，上方的横边是 4 cm。把所有边长加起来：10 + 3 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 10 + 11 = 50 cm。

prompt.en: Trace the L-shaped figure, then write its perimeter.
prompt.zh: 描出 L 形图形外面一圈，再写出周长。

guide.en: Tap every 1 cm segment along the boundary, including the inward turn. Count the segments all the way round, then write the total.
guide.zh: 点出边界上的每段 1 cm 线段，包括凹角。绕一圈数完，再写出总长度。

hints.en: Start at one corner and follow the edge back to it.
hints.zh: 从一个角开始，沿边走回原处。

hints.en: The six straight sides have 8, 2, 3, 3, 5 and 5 unit segments.
hints.zh: 六条直边分别有 8、2、3、3、5 和 5 段。

hints.en: Add the segments on all six sides.
hints.zh: 把六条边上的线段数加起来。

correct.en: Yes. 8 + 2 + 3 + 3 + 5 + 5 = 26 segments of 1 cm go round the figure.

say.en: 31 counts the squares inside the figure: that is its area. Look at the line segments that go round it.
say.zh: 31 是图形里面的格子数，那是面积。要数绕图形一圈的线段。

fallback.en: Not yet. Follow the boundary, including the inward turn, and count each 1 cm segment once.
fallback.zh: 还没对。沿边走，包括凹角，每段 1 cm 线段数一次。

reveal.en: Starting at the bottom-left corner: 8 across, 2 up, 3 left, 3 up, 5 left and 5 down. The perimeter is 26 cm.
reveal.zh: 从左下角开始：向右 8、向上 2、向左 3、向上 3、向左 5、向下 5，周长是 26 cm。

prompt.en: Trace round the U-shaped figure, then write its perimeter.
prompt.zh: 沿 U 形图形描一圈，再写出周长。

guide.en: The boundary follows the notch down, across and up. Tap those segments as well as the outer sides, then count all the 1 cm segments.
guide.zh: 边界会沿着凹口向下、横着走、再向上。把凹口的线段和其余外边都点出来，数出有几段，每段 1 cm。

hints.en: Follow the top edge into the notch instead of crossing the gap.
hints.zh: 沿上边走进凹口，别直接跨过缺口。

hints.en: The notch has 3 segments down, 3 across and 3 up.
hints.zh: 凹口向下 3 段、横着 3 段、向上 3 段。

correct.en: Yes. All eight sides, including the notch, total 30 cm.
correct.zh: 对。八条边都算进去，包括凹口，周长是 30 cm。

say.en: An extra line inside the figure is selected. The perimeter follows its boundary; remove the inside line and keep the three sides of the notch.
say.zh: 你多点了一段图形里面的线。周长沿着边界；撤掉里面的线，保留凹口的三条边。

fallback.en: Not yet. Follow every part of the boundary, including the notch, and count each segment once.
fallback.zh: 还没对。沿整个边界走，包括凹口，每段线数一次。

reveal.en: From the bottom-left corner, the side lengths are 7, 5, 2, 3, 3, 3, 2 and 5 cm. Their sum is 30 cm.
reveal.zh: 从左下角开始，边长依次是 7、5、2、3、3、3、2 和 5 cm，加起来是 30 cm。

prompt.en: Which unmarked side is 5 cm long?
prompt.zh: 哪条没标长度的边是 5 cm？

guide.en: Find both unmarked lengths using the opposite totals. Choose the side whose calculated length is 5 cm.
guide.zh: 用对面的总长度求出两条没标的边，再选出长 5 cm 的那一条。

hints.en: Locate the two unmarked sides at the inward corner.
hints.zh: 找凹角处两条没标长度的边。

hints.en: The horizontal parts total 11 cm; the vertical parts total 8 cm.
hints.zh: 横边合起来是 11 cm；竖边合起来是 8 cm。

hints.en: Compare 11 − 5 with 8 − 3.

text.en: The horizontal side at the inward corner
The vertical side at the inward corner

correct.en: Yes. The vertical side at the inward corner is 8 − 3 = 5 cm. The horizontal side is 11 − 5 = 6 cm.
correct.zh: 对。凹角处的竖边是 8 − 3 = 5 cm，横边是 11 − 5 = 6 cm。

say.en: The horizontal side is 11 − 5 = 6 cm. Use the full height of 8 cm and the lower 3 cm side to find the unmarked vertical side.
say.zh: 横边是 11 − 5 = 6 cm。用 8 cm 的总高度减去下方的 3 cm，求没标的竖边。

fallback.en: Not yet. Match horizontal parts with horizontal totals and vertical parts with vertical totals.
fallback.zh: 还没对。横边对照横向总长度，竖边对照竖向总长度。

reveal.en: The vertical side at the inward corner is 8 − 3 = 5 cm. The horizontal side is 11 − 5 = 6 cm.
reveal.zh: 凹角处的竖边是 8 − 3 = 5 cm，横边是 11 − 5 = 6 cm。

caption.en: Cover a 4 cm by 3 cm rectangle with 1 cm squares, one row at a time: 3 rows of 4.
caption.zh: 用 1 cm 的正方形一行一行地铺 4 cm × 3 cm 的长方形：3 行，每行 4 个。

caption.en: That is an array: 3 rows of 4 is 3 × 4 = 12 squares. The area is 12 cm².
caption.zh: 这就是阵列：3 行、每行 4 个，3 × 4 = 12 个正方形。面积是 12 cm²。

caption.en: Without the squares: the length tells you how many squares in each row, and the breadth tells you how many rows. Area = length × breadth.
caption.zh: 不画方格也一样：长是每行有几个，宽是有几行。面积 = 长 × 宽。

caption.en: Adding 4 + 3 gives 7, which counts no squares at all, and 14 is the perimeter. Multiply to find the area: 12 cm².
caption.zh: 4 + 3 = 7，一个正方形也没数到；14 是周长。求面积要相乘：12 cm²。

caption.en: A square: side × side. 5 × 5 = 25 cm².
caption.zh: 正方形：边长 × 边长。5 × 5 = 25 cm²。

keyFacts.en: Area of a rectangle = length × breadth.
keyFacts.zh: 长方形的面积 = 长 × 宽。

keyFacts.en: Area of a square = side × side.
keyFacts.zh: 正方形的面积 = 边长 × 边长。

keyFacts.en: Area is in square units: cm², m².
keyFacts.zh: 面积用平方单位：cm²、m²。

prompt.en: Draw a rectangle with an area of 18 cm².
prompt.zh: 画一个面积是 18 cm² 的长方形。

guide.en: Drag the corner, or use the length and breadth buttons. The area is length × breadth, so find two numbers that multiply to 18.
guide.zh: 拖动角上的点，或用长、宽按钮。面积 = 长 × 宽，所以要找两个相乘得 18 的数。

hints.en: Which two numbers multiply to make 18?
hints.zh: 哪两个数相乘得 18？

hints.en: 3 rows of 6 squares is one way.
hints.zh: 3 行、每行 6 格是一种画法。

hints.en: Try 6 cm by 3 cm, or 9 cm by 2 cm.
hints.zh: 试试 6 cm × 3 cm，或者 9 cm × 2 cm。

correct.en: Yes. Length × breadth makes 18: an area of 18 cm².
correct.zh: 对。长 × 宽 = 18：面积是 18 cm²。

say.en: Your length and breadth add up to 18, but area is length × breadth. Count the squares inside.
say.zh: 你画的长和宽加起来是 18，可面积是长 × 宽。数一数里面的格子。

say.en: Your rectangle has a perimeter of 18 cm. The area is the squares inside: make 18 squares.
say.zh: 你画的长方形周长是 18 cm。面积是里面的格子：要有 18 格。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count the squares inside your rectangle: are there 18?
fallback.zh: 还没对。数一数你画的长方形里的格子，是 18 个吗？

reveal.en: 6 cm by 3 cm, 9 cm by 2 cm or 3 cm by 6 cm all have an area of 18 cm².
reveal.zh: 6 cm × 3 cm、9 cm × 2 cm 或 3 cm × 6 cm，面积都是 18 cm²。

prompt.en: Find the area of this rectangular sheet of paper.
prompt.zh: 求这张长方形纸的面积。

guide.en: Read the labelled length and breadth. Imagine rows of 1 cm squares covering the paper, then multiply the two lengths.
guide.zh: 看标出的长和宽。想象用边长 1 cm 的正方形一行一行地铺满，再把长和宽相乘。

hints.en: Look at the two labelled sides.
hints.zh: 看标出的长和宽。

hints.en: Use length × breadth to count all the squares.
hints.zh: 用长 × 宽，求所有正方形的总数。

hints.en: Calculate 12 × 7, then choose cm².
hints.zh: 算 12 × 7，再选 cm²。

correct.en: Yes. 12 × 7 = 84, so the area is 84 cm². The unit counts squares.
correct.zh: 对。12 × 7 = 84，面积是 84 cm²。数的是正方形的个数，所以用平方单位。

say.en: 12 + 7 adds two side lengths. Area counts the squares covering the inside; use length × breadth.
say.zh: 12 + 7 是两条边长的和。面积数铺满里面的正方形，要用长 × 宽。

say.en: 38 is the distance that goes round the figure. Look at the inside: its area comes from length × breadth.
say.zh: 38 是绕图形一圈的长度。看里面铺满的面，面积要用长 × 宽。

say.en: 84 counts squares, so use cm². The unit cm measures a length; look at the area unit chips.
say.zh: 84 对了，可面积要写 cm²。cm 是长度单位，再看一下单位选项。

fallback.en: Not yet. Read the labelled sides and use length × breadth. Choose a square unit for the area.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看标出的边长，用长 × 宽。面积要选平方单位。

reveal.en: The area is 12 × 7 = 84 cm²: 7 rows of 12 unit squares cover the figure.
reveal.zh: 面积是 12 × 7 = 84 cm²：7 行、每行 12 个单位正方形，正好铺满。

prompt.en: Find the area of this rectangular bedroom floor.
prompt.zh: 求这个长方形卧室地面的面积。

guide.en: Use the labelled measurements of the floor. The length gives the squares in each row and the breadth gives the number of rows.
guide.zh: 用图中标出的地面尺寸。长表示每行有几个正方形，宽表示有几行。

hints.en: Look at the two labelled sides.
hints.zh: 看标出的长和宽。

hints.en: Use length × breadth to count all the squares.
hints.zh: 用长 × 宽，求所有正方形的总数。

hints.en: Calculate 9 × 6, then choose m².
hints.zh: 算 9 × 6，再选 m²。

correct.en: Yes. 9 × 6 = 54, so the area is 54 m². The unit counts squares.
correct.zh: 对。9 × 6 = 54，面积是 54 m²。数的是正方形的个数，所以用平方单位。

say.en: 9 + 6 adds two side lengths. Area counts the squares covering the inside; use length × breadth.
say.zh: 9 + 6 是两条边长的和。面积数铺满里面的正方形，要用长 × 宽。

say.en: 30 is the distance that goes round the figure. Look at the inside: its area comes from length × breadth.
say.zh: 30 是绕图形一圈的长度。看里面铺满的面，面积要用长 × 宽。

say.en: 54 counts squares, so use m². The unit m measures a length; look at the area unit chips.
say.zh: 54 对了，可面积要写 m²。m 是长度单位，再看一下单位选项。

fallback.en: Not yet. Read the labelled sides and use length × breadth. Choose a square unit for the area.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看标出的边长，用长 × 宽。面积要选平方单位。

reveal.en: The area is 9 × 6 = 54 m²: 6 rows of 9 unit squares cover the figure.
reveal.zh: 面积是 9 × 6 = 54 m²：6 行、每行 9 个单位正方形，正好铺满。

prompt.en: Find the area of this square tile.
prompt.zh: 求这块正方形砖的面积。

guide.en: Read the labelled side of the square. Multiply the side by itself to count the 1 cm squares that cover the tile.
guide.zh: 看正方形标出的边长。用边长乘边长，求铺满这块砖需要几个边长 1 cm 的正方形。

hints.en: Look at the labelled side.
hints.zh: 看标出的边长。

hints.en: Use side × side to count all the squares.
hints.zh: 用边长 × 边长，求所有正方形的总数。

hints.en: Calculate 6 × 6, then choose cm².
hints.zh: 算 6 × 6，再选 cm²。

correct.en: Yes. 6 × 6 = 36, so the area is 36 cm². The unit counts squares.
correct.zh: 对。6 × 6 = 36，面积是 36 cm²。数的是正方形的个数，所以用平方单位。

say.en: 6 + 6 adds two side lengths. Area counts the squares covering the inside; use side × side.
say.zh: 6 + 6 是两条边长的和。面积数铺满里面的正方形，要用边长 × 边长。

say.en: 24 is the distance that goes round the figure. Look at the inside: its area comes from side × side.
say.zh: 24 是绕图形一圈的长度。看里面铺满的面，面积要用边长 × 边长。

say.en: 36 counts squares, so use cm². The unit cm measures a length; look at the area unit chips.
say.zh: 36 对了，可面积要写 cm²。cm 是长度单位，再看一下单位选项。

fallback.en: Not yet. Read the labelled sides and use side × side. Choose a square unit for the area.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看标出的边长，用边长 × 边长。面积要选平方单位。

reveal.en: The area is 6 × 6 = 36 cm²: 6 rows of 6 unit squares cover the figure.
reveal.zh: 面积是 6 × 6 = 36 cm²：6 行、每行 6 个单位正方形，正好铺满。

prompt.en: Draw a rectangle with an area of 16 cm².
prompt.zh: 画一个面积是 16 cm² 的长方形。

guide.en: Drag the corner or use the length and breadth buttons. Choose two side lengths whose product counts 16 squares inside.
guide.zh: 拖动角上的点，或用长、宽按钮。找两个相乘得 16 的边长，让里面有 16 格。

hints.en: Look for rows of equal length on the grid.
hints.zh: 看方格，想一想每行要有几个格子。

hints.en: Find two numbers that multiply to 16 and fit the grid.
hints.zh: 找两个相乘得 16、又能画在方格里的数。

hints.en: Try 8 squares across and 2 rows up.
hints.zh: 试试横着 8 格、竖着 2 行。

correct.en: Yes. Your length × breadth is 16, so 16 unit squares cover your rectangle. Its area is 16 cm².
correct.zh: 对。你画的长 × 宽 = 16，里面铺满 16 个单位正方形，面积是 16 cm²。

say.en: Your length and breadth add to 16. Look at the rows inside: multiply the sides to count the area.
say.zh: 你画的长和宽加起来是 16。看里面的每一行，求面积要把长和宽相乘。

say.en: Your rectangle measures 16 cm all the way round. Look inside and make the area 16 cm² by covering 16 squares.
say.zh: 你画的长方形绕一圈是 16 cm。看里面，要铺满 16 格，面积才是 16 cm²。

fallback.en: Not yet. Multiply the length by the breadth of your rectangle. Adjust the corner until the product is 16.
fallback.zh: 还没对。把你画的长和宽相乘，再调整角上的点，让乘积是 16。

reveal.en: One way is 8 cm by 2 cm: 8 × 2 = 16 cm². A 4 cm by 4 cm square also works.
reveal.zh: 一种画法是 8 cm × 2 cm：8 × 2 = 16 cm²。4 cm × 4 cm 的正方形也可以。

prompt.en: Draw a rectangle with an area of 24 cm².
prompt.zh: 画一个面积是 24 cm² 的长方形。

guide.en: Choose how many squares go in each row and how many rows you need. Drag the corner so those two numbers multiply to 24.
guide.zh: 想好每行有几格、一共有几行。拖动角上的点，让这两个数相乘得 24。

hints.en: The area counts every square inside the rectangle.
hints.zh: 面积数的是长方形里面的所有格子。

hints.en: Use a multiplication fact with a product of 24.
hints.zh: 想一个乘积是 24 的乘法算式。

hints.en: You could make 3 rows with 8 squares in each row.
hints.zh: 可以画 3 行，每行 8 格。

correct.en: Yes. Length × breadth gives 24 squares covering the inside, so your rectangle has an area of 24 cm².
correct.zh: 对。长 × 宽得到里面的 24 格，所以你画的长方形面积是 24 cm²。

say.en: Your rectangle has a perimeter of 24 cm. Look at the squares inside: the area must be 24 cm².
say.zh: 你画的长方形周长是 24 cm。看里面的格子，面积要是 24 cm²。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count the squares in a row and multiply by the number of rows. Adjust the rectangle to cover 24 squares.
fallback.zh: 还没对。数一行有几格，再乘行数。调整长方形，让它铺满 24 格。

reveal.en: 8 cm by 3 cm works because 8 × 3 = 24 cm². You can also draw 6 cm by 4 cm.
reveal.zh: 8 cm × 3 cm 可以，因为 8 × 3 = 24 cm²。也可以画 6 cm × 4 cm。

prompt.en: Lay one full row and one full column of squares, then write the area.
prompt.zh: 铺一整行和一整列正方形，再写面积。

guide.en: Lay squares across one complete row and up one complete column. Use the squares in a row and the number of rows to find the area that covers the whole rectangle.
guide.zh: 铺一整行，再铺一整列。用每行的正方形个数乘行数，求铺满整个长方形的面积。

hints.en: Each small square covers 1 cm². Look across a full row and up a full column.
hints.zh: 每个小正方形的面积是 1 cm²。横着看一整行，竖着看一整列。

hints.en: The column tells you how many equal rows there are. Multiply rows by squares in a row.
hints.zh: 一列告诉你有几行。用行数乘每行的正方形个数。

hints.en: There are 5 rows of 8 squares. Calculate 5 × 8 and choose cm².
hints.zh: 有 5 行，每行 8 个正方形。算 5 × 8，再选 cm²。

correct.en: Yes. There are 5 rows of 8 unit squares, so 5 × 8 = 40 cm² covers the rectangle.
correct.zh: 对。有 5 行，每行 8 个单位正方形，所以面积是 5 × 8 = 40 cm²。

say.en: 8 + 5 adds the side lengths. Look at the full rows inside and multiply the number of rows by 8.
say.zh: 8 + 5 是长和宽相加。看里面的整行，要用行数乘 8。

say.en: 26 counts the distance that goes round the edge. Look at the rows of squares covering the inside to find the area.
say.zh: 26 是绕边一圈的长度。求面积要看铺满里面的正方形有几行。

say.en: 40 is the number of squares that cover the figure. Choose cm² for their area; cm measures a length.
say.zh: 40 是铺满图形的正方形个数。面积要选 cm²，cm 是长度单位。

fallback.en: Not yet. Complete a full row and a full column first. Then multiply the rows by the squares in each row and choose cm².
fallback.zh: 还没对。先铺好一整行和一整列，再用行数乘每行的正方形个数，选 cm²。

reveal.en: A full row has 8 squares and a full column shows 5 rows. The area is 5 × 8 = 40 cm².
reveal.zh: 一整行有 8 个正方形，一整列表示有 5 行。面积是 5 × 8 = 40 cm²。

prompt.en: Choose the calculation that finds the area of this rectangle.
prompt.zh: 选出求这个长方形面积的算式。

guide.en: Read the length and breadth. Choose the calculation that counts equal rows of squares covering the inside.
guide.zh: 看长和宽。选出能算出铺满里面的正方形总数的算式。

hints.en: Look at the two labelled sides.
hints.zh: 看标出的两条边。

hints.en: Area = length × breadth.
hints.zh: 面积 = 长 × 宽。

hints.en: Count 4 rows with 10 squares in each row.
hints.zh: 数 4 行，每行 10 个正方形。

correct.en: Yes. 10 × 4 counts 4 rows of 10 squares, so the area is 40 cm².
correct.zh: 对。10 × 4 算的是 4 行、每行 10 个正方形，面积是 40 cm²。

say.en: 10 + 4 adds a length and a breadth. Look inside the rectangle: multiply them to count all the squares.
say.zh: 10 + 4 把长和宽相加。看长方形里面，要把长和宽相乘来求所有正方形的总数。

say.en: 2 × (10 + 4) finds the distance that goes round the rectangle. Look at the rows inside and use length × breadth.
say.zh: 2 × (10 + 4) 求的是绕长方形一圈的长度。看里面的每一行，面积要用长 × 宽。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look for a calculation that multiplies the two labelled sides to count squares.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找把标出的两条边相乘、求正方形总数的算式。

reveal.en: Choose 10 × 4 = 40 cm². Multiplication counts the squares covering all 4 rows.
reveal.zh: 选 10 × 4 = 40 cm²。用乘法求铺满 4 行的正方形总数。

prompt.en: Choose the area of this square.
prompt.zh: 选出这个正方形的面积。

guide.en: Use the labelled side for both factors. Choose a square unit because you are measuring the surface it covers.
guide.zh: 两个因数都用标出的边长。量的是铺满的面，所以要选平方单位。

hints.en: All sides of this square are 7 m.
hints.zh: 这个正方形每条边都是 7 m。

hints.en: Use side × side to find the area.
hints.zh: 用边长 × 边长求面积。

hints.en: Calculate 7 × 7 and look for the answer in m².
hints.zh: 算 7 × 7，再找单位是 m² 的答案。

correct.en: Yes. 7 × 7 = 49, and square metres measure the area covered: 49 m².
correct.zh: 对。7 × 7 = 49，面积用平方米来量，所以是 49 m²。

say.en: 28 comes from adding the four sides to go round the square. Look at the surface inside and use side × side.
say.zh: 28 是四条边相加，求的是绕一圈的长度。看里面铺满的面，要用边长 × 边长。

say.en: 49 is the number of 1 m squares covering the square. Look at the units: their area is measured in m².
say.zh: 49 对了，可 m 是长度单位。面积要用平方单位 m²。

say.en: 14 adds two sides of 7 m. Look at the rows covering the square and multiply 7 by 7.
say.zh: 14 把两条 7 m 的边相加。看铺满里面的每一行，要算 7 × 7。

fallback.en: Not yet. Multiply the side by itself and choose a square unit for the surface.
fallback.zh: 还没对。用边长乘边长，再为铺满的面选平方单位。

reveal.en: Choose 49 m² because the area is 7 × 7 = 49 m².
reveal.zh: 选 49 m²，因为面积是 7 × 7 = 49 m²。

prompt.en: Choose the rectangle with an area of 12 cm².
prompt.zh: 选出面积是 12 cm² 的长方形。

guide.en: Read the side lengths on each picture. Multiply length × breadth for each one to find which surface takes 12 unit squares to cover.
guide.zh: 看每幅图标出的边长，各算一算长 × 宽，找出能用 12 个单位正方形铺满的长方形。

hints.en: Look at the dimensions on each picture rather than its apparent size.
hints.zh: 看每幅图的尺寸，不要只看画出来的大小。

hints.en: Area comes from multiplying the sides, even for a square.
hints.zh: 面积要把两条边相乘，正方形也一样。

hints.en: One picture has 3 rows of 4 squares.
hints.zh: 有一幅图是 3 行、每行 4 个正方形。

correct.en: Yes. The 4 cm by 3 cm rectangle has 3 rows of 4 squares, giving an area of 12 cm².
correct.zh: 对。4 cm × 3 cm 的长方形有 3 行、每行 4 个正方形，面积是 12 cm²。

say.en: 6 + 6 makes 12 by adding the side lengths. Look inside that square: 6 × 6 counts the squares covering its area.
say.zh: 6 + 6 是把边长相加得到 12。看这个正方形里面，求面积要算 6 × 6。

say.en: The 3 cm by 3 cm square measures 12 cm all the way round. Look at the inside: its area is 3 × 3, not its perimeter.
say.zh: 3 cm × 3 cm 的正方形绕一圈是 12 cm。看里面，面积要算 3 × 3，不能用周长。

fallback.en: Not yet. Multiply the two side lengths of each picture and look for a product of 12.
fallback.zh: 还没对。把每幅图的两条边长相乘，找乘积是 12 的。

reveal.en: Choose the 4 cm by 3 cm rectangle: 4 × 3 = 12 cm². The other areas are 36 cm² and 9 cm².
reveal.zh: 选 4 cm × 3 cm 的长方形：4 × 3 = 12 cm²。另外两幅图的面积是 36 cm² 和 9 cm²。

caption.en: 12 square tiles in one long row: area 12 square units, perimeter 26 units.
caption.zh: 12 块方砖排成一长行：面积 12 平方单位，周长 26 个单位长。

caption.en: The same 12 tiles as 2 rows of 6: the area is still 12, but the perimeter is now 16.
caption.zh: 同样 12 块排成 2 行、每行 6 块：面积还是 12，周长变成 16。

caption.en: 3 rows of 4: area 12, perimeter 14. Same area, three different perimeters. The closer to a square, the shorter the way round.
caption.zh: 3 行、每行 4 块：面积 12，周长 14。面积一样，周长有三种。越接近正方形，绕一圈越短。

caption.en: It works the other way too. A 7 by 1 strip and a 4 by 4 square both have a perimeter of 16, but their areas are 7 and 16.
caption.zh: 反过来也一样：7 × 1 的长条和 4 × 4 的正方形，周长都是 16，面积一个是 7，一个是 16。

keyFacts.en: Shapes with the same area can have different perimeters.
keyFacts.zh: 面积相同，周长可以不同。

keyFacts.en: Shapes with the same perimeter can have different areas.
keyFacts.zh: 周长相同，面积也可以不同。

text.en: Neither: the same tiles make the same perimeter
text.zh: 一样长：同样的方砖，周长也一样

prompt.en: Both shapes are made of 6 square tiles. Which one has the longer perimeter?
prompt.zh: 两个图形都是用 6 块方砖拼成的。哪一个周长更长？

guide.en: Same area does not mean same perimeter. Count the sides round each shape, or work them out from the lengths.
guide.zh: 面积一样，周长不一定一样。数一数每个图形外面一圈有几段，或者用长和宽算一算。

hints.en: Walk round each shape and count the sides.
hints.zh: 绕每个图形走一圈，数一数有几段。

correct.en: Yes. A goes round 14 units and B only 10, though both cover 6 squares.
correct.zh: 对。A 绕一圈是 14 个单位长，B 只有 10 个，虽然两个都铺了 6 格。

say.en: Both have the same area, 6 squares, but their perimeters are not the same. Walk round each one.
say.zh: 两个面积都是 6 格，可周长不一样。各走一圈看看。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count the sides round each shape.
fallback.zh: 还没对。数一数每个图形外面一圈的段数。

reveal.en: A's perimeter is 2 × (6 + 1) = 14 units, B's is 2 × (3 + 2) = 10 units. The long thin shape has the longer way round.
reveal.zh: A 的周长是 2 × (6 + 1) = 14 个单位长，B 的是 2 × (3 + 2) = 10 个单位长。又细又长的那个绕一圈更长。

prompt.en: Draw a rectangle with an area of 12 square units and a perimeter of 14 units.
prompt.zh: 画一个面积是 12 平方单位、周长是 14 个单位长的长方形。

guide.en: Find lengths that multiply to the area. Check that two lengths and two breadths give the required perimeter.
guide.zh: 先找出相乘得 12 的长和宽，再检查两个长加两个宽是不是 14。

hints.en: You need to meet both conditions.
hints.zh: 面积和周长两个条件都要满足。

hints.en: Try different pairs of whole numbers whose product is 12.
hints.zh: 试一试乘积为 12 的不同整数对。

hints.en: The length and breadth must add to 7 units.
hints.zh: 长加宽必须等于 7 个单位长。

correct.en: Yes. 4 × 3 covers 12 square units, and 2 × (4 + 3) goes round 14 units.
correct.zh: 对。4 × 3 铺满 12 平方单位，2 × (4 + 3) 算出绕一圈是 14 个单位长。

say.en: Your rectangle covers 12 square units, but it goes round a different distance. Check all four sides.
say.zh: 你画的长方形面积是 12 平方单位，可周长不是 14 个单位长。把四条边加起来再看看。

fallback.en: Not yet. Multiply the length by the breadth, then add all four sides.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先算长乘宽，再把四条边加起来。

reveal.en: Use a length of 4 units and a breadth of 3 units. The area is 4 × 3 = 12 square units and the perimeter is 4 + 3 + 4 + 3 = 14 units. Either way round works.
reveal.zh: 长取 4 个单位长，宽取 3 个单位长。面积是 4 × 3 = 12 平方单位，周长是 4 + 3 + 4 + 3 = 14 个单位长。横放或竖放都可以。

prompt.en: Draw a rectangular card with an area of 16 cm² and a perimeter of 20 cm.
prompt.zh: 画一张长方形卡片，面积为 16 cm²，周长为 20 cm。

guide.en: Different rectangles can cover the same area. Try a factor pair of 16 and check the distance round the card.
guide.zh: 不同的长方形可以铺满相同的面积。试一组乘积为 16 的长和宽，再检查卡片绕一圈的长度。

hints.en: An area of 16 cm² alone does not tell you the perimeter.
hints.zh: 只知道面积是 16 cm²，还不能确定周长。

hints.en: Multiply to check the area; double the sum to check the perimeter.
hints.zh: 用长乘宽检查面积，用长加宽的和乘 2 检查周长。

hints.en: Look for a factor pair of 16 whose sum is 10.
hints.zh: 找出乘积为 16、和为 10 的两个整数。

correct.en: Yes. 8 × 2 = 16 cm² and 2 × (8 + 2) = 20 cm. Both conditions hold.

say.en: A 4 cm by 4 cm square covers 16 cm², but its perimeter is 16 cm. Check the required distance round the card.
say.zh: 边长为 4 cm 的正方形面积是 16 cm²，但周长是 16 cm。再看卡片所需的周长。

say.en: These sides go round 16 cm. The number 16 describes the area, so check how many squares your rectangle covers.
say.zh: 你画的长方形绕一圈是 16 cm。题目里的 16 cm² 是面积，要看里面铺满多少格。

fallback.en: Not yet. The card must cover 16 cm² and go round 20 cm. Check each condition.
fallback.zh: 还没对。卡片要铺满 16 cm²，绕一圈是 20 cm。逐一检查两个条件。

reveal.en: A length of 8 cm and a breadth of 2 cm give an area of 8 × 2 = 16 cm² and a perimeter of 8 + 2 + 8 + 2 = 20 cm. You can turn the card.
reveal.zh: 长为 8 cm、宽为 2 cm 时，面积是 8 × 2 = 16 cm²，周长是 8 + 2 + 8 + 2 = 20 cm。卡片转个方向也可以。

prompt.en: Draw a rectangle that covers 24 square units and goes round 22 units.
prompt.zh: 画一个面积是 24 平方单位、周长是 22 个单位长的长方形。

guide.en: Keep the area fixed while trying different lengths and breadths. Each time, check the total of the four sides.
guide.zh: 试不同的长和宽，让面积保持不变。每试一次，都检查四条边的总长度。

hints.en: More than one rectangle can cover 24 square units.
hints.zh: 铺满 24 平方单位的长方形不止一种。

hints.en: For a perimeter of 22 units, one length and one breadth add to 11 units.
hints.zh: 周长为 22 个单位长时，一个长加一个宽等于 11 个单位长。

hints.en: Try a length of 8 units and find the breadth from the area.
hints.zh: 先把长定为 8 个单位长，再用面积求宽。

correct.en: Yes. 8 × 3 covers 24 square units and 8 + 3 + 8 + 3 goes round 22 units.
correct.zh: 对。8 × 3 铺满 24 平方单位，8 + 3 + 8 + 3 算出绕一圈是 22 个单位长。

say.en: A 6 by 4 rectangle has the required area, but goes round 20 units. Try another rectangle with the same area.
say.zh: 6 × 4 的长方形面积符合要求，但绕一圈是 20 个单位长。试另一个面积相同的长方形。

fallback.en: Not yet. Check the product of the two side lengths and the sum of all four sides.
fallback.zh: 还没对。检查长与宽的乘积，以及四条边的和。

reveal.en: Draw an 8 by 3 rectangle, or turn it. Its area is 8 × 3 = 24 square units and its perimeter is 2 × (8 + 3) = 22 units.
reveal.zh: 画一个 8 × 3 的长方形，或转个方向。面积是 8 × 3 = 24 平方单位，周长是 2 × (8 + 3) = 22 个单位长。

prompt.en: Each figure covers 8 square units. Which has the longest perimeter?
prompt.zh: 每个图形都铺满 8 平方单位。哪个周长最长？

text.en: All three, because their areas are equal
text.zh: 三个一样长，因为面积相同

guide.en: Each figure uses the same number of squares. Compare the distance round the outside of each figure.
guide.zh: 每个图形用的格子数相同。比较各个图形绕外面一圈的长度。

hints.en: Trace the outside of each figure with your eyes.
hints.zh: 沿着每个图形的外边看一圈。
