hints.en: A has sides 4 and 2; B has sides 8 and 1; C has sides 2 and 4.
hints.zh: A 的长和宽是 4 和 2，B 是 8 和 1，C 是 2 和 4。

correct.en: Yes. B goes round 18 units; A and C each go round 12 units. All three cover 8 square units.
correct.zh: 对。B 绕一圈是 18 个单位长，A 和 C 各是 12 个单位长。三个都铺满 8 平方单位。

say.en: Equal areas do not guarantee equal perimeters. Count the outside sides of A, B and C separately.
say.zh: 面积相同，周长不一定相同。分别数一数 A、B、C 外面一圈的线段。

fallback.en: Not yet. Compare the whole way round each figure.
fallback.zh: 还没对。比较每个图形绕完整一圈的长度。

reveal.en: A: 2 × (4 + 2) = 12 units. B: 2 × (8 + 1) = 18 units. C: 2 × (2 + 4) = 12 units. B has the longest perimeter.

prompt.en: Which two figures have the same area?
prompt.zh: 哪两个图形的面积相同？

text.en: A and B, because both have perimeter 16 units
text.zh: A 和 B，因为周长都是 16 个单位长

guide.en: Count the squares that cover each figure, or multiply its length and breadth. A matching perimeter alone does not show a matching area.
guide.zh: 数出铺满各图形的格子数，或算长乘宽。只知道周长相同，还不能确定面积相同。

hints.en: Look inside each figure at the rows of squares.
hints.zh: 看看各个图形里面有几行格子。

hints.en: Use 6 × 2 for A, 5 × 3 for B, and 4 × 3 for C.

correct.en: Yes. A and C each cover 12 square units, though their perimeters differ.
correct.zh: 对。A 和 C 都铺满 12 平方单位，虽然周长不同。

say.en: A and B both go round 16 units, but they cover different numbers of squares. Compare their rows.
say.zh: A 和 B 绕一圈都是 16 个单位长，但铺满的格子数不同。比较它们的行数和每行格子数。

fallback.en: Not yet. Compare how many unit squares cover each figure.
fallback.zh: 还没对。比较铺满每个图形要用多少个单位正方形。

reveal.en: A covers 6 × 2 = 12 square units, B covers 5 × 3 = 15, and C covers 4 × 3 = 12. Choose A and C. Their perimeters are 16 and 14 units.
reveal.zh: A 铺满 6 × 2 = 12 平方单位，B 铺满 5 × 3 = 15 平方单位，C 铺满 4 × 3 = 12 平方单位。选 A 和 C，它们的周长分别是 16 和 14 个单位长。

prompt.en: These card layouts each cover 24 cm². Which has the longest perimeter?
prompt.zh: 这些卡片图样各铺满 24 cm²。哪个周长最长？

text.en: All three, because each covers 24 cm²
text.zh: 三个一样长，因为都铺满 24 cm²

guide.en: The area stays the same when the side lengths change. Add the four sides of each layout to compare perimeters.
guide.zh: 长和宽改变时，面积可以保持相同。把各个图样的四条边加起来，比较周长。

hints.en: Compare the outside edges of the three layouts.
hints.zh: 比较三个图样的外边。

hints.en: Find twice the sum of the length and breadth for each layout.
hints.zh: 分别把长加宽的和乘 2。

correct.en: Yes. C goes round 28 cm, compared with 20 cm for A and 22 cm for B.
correct.zh: 对。C 绕一圈是 28 cm，A 是 20 cm，B 是 22 cm。

say.en: All three cover 24 cm², but their side lengths differ. Add the outside sides of each one.
say.zh: 三个都铺满 24 cm²，但长和宽不同。分别把外面的四条边加起来。

fallback.en: Not yet. Equal areas can have different distances round them. Check each perimeter.
fallback.zh: 还没对。面积相同，绕一圈的长度可以不同。逐一检查周长。

reveal.en: A has perimeter 2 × (6 + 4) = 20 cm, B has 2 × (8 + 3) = 22 cm, and C has 2 × (12 + 2) = 28 cm. C has the longest perimeter.

prompt.en: A and B each cover 20 square units. What is the perimeter of B?
prompt.zh: A 和 B 各铺满 20 平方单位。B 的周长是多少？

guide.en: Use the side lengths of B to find its perimeter. Having the same area as A does not fix its distance round.
guide.zh: 用 B 的长和宽求它的周长。面积和 A 相同，绕一圈的长度却不一定相同。

hints.en: Follow the outside of B, the lower figure.
hints.zh: 沿着下面的图形 B 的外边走一圈。

hints.en: B is 10 units long and 2 units broad. Add all four sides.
hints.zh: B 长 10 个单位长、宽 2 个单位长。把四条边加起来。

hints.en: Work out 10 + 2 + 10 + 2.

correct.en: Yes. B goes round 10 + 2 + 10 + 2 = 24 units. A has the same area but a perimeter of 18 units.
correct.zh: 对。B 绕一圈是 10 + 2 + 10 + 2 = 24 个单位长。A 的面积相同，周长却是 18 个单位长。

say.en: 18 units is the perimeter of A. Use the sides of B, even though both figures cover 20 square units.
say.zh: 18 个单位长是 A 的周长。虽然两个图形都铺满 20 平方单位，还是要用 B 的边来算。

say.en: 10 + 2 counts only one length and one breadth. Continue round the other two sides of B.
say.zh: 10 + 2 只算了一个长和一个宽。还要加上 B 的另外两条边。

say.en: 20 is the number of square units covered. For perimeter, count the unit sides round B.
say.zh: 20 是铺满图形的平方单位数，那是面积。求周长要数 B 外面一圈的单位线段。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count all four sides round B.
fallback.zh: 还没对。数完 B 外面一圈的四条边。

reveal.en: B has two sides of 10 units and two of 2 units, so its perimeter is 2 × (10 + 2) = 24 units. A covers the same area but goes round 2 × (5 + 4) = 18 units.
reveal.zh: B 有两条 10 个单位长的边和两条 2 个单位长的边，周长是 2 × (10 + 2) = 24 个单位长。A 铺满相同的面积，绕一圈却是 2 × (5 + 4) = 18 个单位长。

prompt.en: A and B each cover 36 cm². Give the perimeter of B with its unit.
prompt.zh: A 和 B 各铺满 36 cm²。写出 B 的周长和单位。

guide.en: Read the side lengths of B from its grid. Add all four sides and use a unit for length.
guide.zh: 从方格读出 B 的长和宽，把四条边加起来，单位用长度单位。

hints.en: B is the tall rectangle on the right.
hints.zh: B 是右边竖着的长方形。

hints.en: Its length is 9 cm and its breadth is 4 cm.
hints.zh: 它的长是 9 cm，宽是 4 cm。

hints.en: Double 9 + 4, then choose the unit for the distance round a figure.
hints.zh: 把 9 + 4 的和乘 2，再选量长度的单位。

correct.en: Yes. B goes round 2 × (9 + 4) = 26 cm. A covers the same area but goes round 24 cm.
correct.zh: 对。B 绕一圈是 2 × (9 + 4) = 26 cm。A 铺满的面积相同，绕一圈却是 24 cm。

say.en: 24 cm is the perimeter of square A. For B, use its own two long sides and two short sides.
say.zh: 24 cm 是正方形 A 的周长。求 B 的周长，要用它自己的两条长边和两条短边。

say.en: The number gives the distance round B, so choose cm. Square centimetres measure the area covered.
say.zh: 这个数是 B 绕一圈的长度，单位要选 cm；cm² 是量面积的单位。

say.en: That counts squares along the edge. Perimeter counts the outside sides, including two at each corner square.
say.zh: 你数的是边上的格子。周长要数外面的线段，每个角上的格子有两条边在外面。

fallback.en: Not yet. Add all four sides of B and check the unit.
fallback.zh: 还没对。把 B 的四条边加起来，再检查单位。

reveal.en: B has perimeter 9 + 4 + 9 + 4 = 26 cm. A has perimeter 6 + 6 + 6 + 6 = 24 cm. Both areas are 36 cm², so equal area does not guarantee equal perimeter.
reveal.zh: B 的周长是 9 + 4 + 9 + 4 = 26 cm。A 的周长是 6 + 6 + 6 + 6 = 24 cm。两者面积都是 36 cm²，周长却不同：面积相同，周长不一定相同。

caption.en: A rectangle has an area of 24 cm² and a length of 6 cm. What is its breadth?
caption.zh: 一个长方形面积 24 cm²，长 6 cm。宽是多少？

caption.en: Think in rows of 6 squares. How many rows make 24? 24 ÷ 6 = 4, so the breadth is 4 cm.
caption.zh: 按每行 6 个正方形来想：几行才有 24 个？24 ÷ 6 = 4，宽是 4 cm。

caption.en: Another rectangle has a perimeter of 20 cm and a length of 6 cm. Half the way round is one length and one breadth: 20 ÷ 2 = 10 cm.
caption.zh: 另一个长方形周长 20 cm，长 6 cm。走半圈正好是一条长加一条宽：20 ÷ 2 = 10 cm。

caption.en: So the breadth is 10 − 6 = 4 cm. Working out 20 − 6 = 14 gives the other three sides together, not one breadth.
caption.zh: 所以宽是 10 − 6 = 4 cm。用 20 − 6 = 14，算出的是另外三条边的和，不是一条宽。

keyFacts.en: Breadth = area ÷ length.
keyFacts.zh: 宽 = 面积 ÷ 长。

keyFacts.en: Half the perimeter = length + breadth.
keyFacts.zh: 周长的一半 = 长 + 宽。

prompt.en: A rectangular garden has a perimeter of 30 m and a length of 9 m. What is its breadth?
prompt.zh: 一个长方形花园周长 30 m，长 9 m。宽是多少？

guide.en: Half the way round is one length and one breadth. Halve the perimeter, then take away the length.
guide.zh: 走半圈正好是一条长加一条宽。先把周长除以 2，再减去长。

hints.en: What is half of the perimeter?
hints.zh: 周长的一半是多少？

hints.en: Half the perimeter = length + breadth.
hints.zh: 周长的一半 = 长 + 宽。

correct.en: Yes. 30 ÷ 2 = 15 and 15 − 9 = 6: the breadth is 6 m.

say.en: 30 − 9 = 21 is the other three sides together. Halve the perimeter first: that is one length and one breadth.
say.zh: 30 − 9 = 21 是另外三条边的和。先把周长除以 2，得到一条长加一条宽。

fallback.en: Not yet. Start from half the perimeter.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先求周长的一半。

reveal.en: Half of 30 m is 15 m, one length and one breadth. 15 − 9 = 6 m.
reveal.zh: 30 m 的一半是 15 m，是一条长加一条宽。15 − 9 = 6 m。

prompt.en: A rectangular card has area 24 cm² and length 8 cm. Find its breadth.
prompt.zh: 长方形卡片面积 24 cm²，长 8 cm。求宽。

guide.en: Look at the area note and the labelled length. Divide the area by the length to find the breadth.
guide.zh: 看面积和标出的长。用面积除以长，求出宽。

hints.en: Which side is labelled, and which side has a question mark?
hints.zh: 哪条边标了长度？哪条边标了问号？

hints.en: Area ÷ length = breadth.
hints.zh: 面积 ÷ 长 = 宽。

hints.en: Work out 24 ÷ 8.

correct.en: Yes. 24 ÷ 8 = 3, so the breadth is 3 cm.
correct.zh: 对。24 ÷ 8 = 3，所以宽是 3 cm。

say.en: 24 ÷ 2 − 8 treats the area as a perimeter. Look at the area note: divide by the length.
say.zh: 24 ÷ 2 − 8 是已知周长时的办法，这里给的是面积。要用面积除以长。

fallback.en: Not yet. Use the area note and the labelled length to find the side marked ?.
fallback.zh: 还没对。用面积和标出的长，求问号处的边长。

reveal.en: Area = length × breadth. 24 ÷ 8 = 3, so the missing breadth is 3 cm.
reveal.zh: 面积 = 长 × 宽。24 ÷ 8 = 3，所以宽是 3 cm。

prompt.en: A rectangle has area 36 cm² and breadth 4 cm. Find its length.
prompt.zh: 长方形面积 36 cm²，宽 4 cm。求长。

guide.en: You know the breadth and the area it covers. Find the length that multiplies with the breadth to make the area.
guide.zh: 已知宽和面积。想一想：宽乘多少才等于面积？

hints.en: Which side is labelled, and which side has a question mark?
hints.zh: 哪条边标了长度？哪条边标了问号？

hints.en: Area ÷ breadth = length.
hints.zh: 面积 ÷ 宽 = 长。

hints.en: Work out 36 ÷ 4.

correct.en: Yes. 36 ÷ 4 = 9, so the length is 9 cm.
correct.zh: 对。36 ÷ 4 = 9，所以长是 9 cm。

say.en: 36 ÷ 2 − 4 treats the area as a perimeter. Look at the area note: divide by the breadth.
say.zh: 36 ÷ 2 − 4 是已知周长时的办法，这里给的是面积。要用面积除以宽。

fallback.en: Not yet. Use the area note and the labelled breadth to find the side marked ?.
fallback.zh: 还没对。用面积和标出的宽，求问号处的边长。

reveal.en: Area = length × breadth. 36 ÷ 4 = 9, so the missing length is 9 cm.
reveal.zh: 面积 = 长 × 宽。36 ÷ 4 = 9，所以长是 9 cm。

prompt.en: A rectangular floor has area 60 m² and length 12 m. Find its breadth.
prompt.zh: 长方形地面面积 60 m²，长 12 m。求宽。

guide.en: Think of rows of square metres covering the floor. Divide the total area by the length of each row.
guide.zh: 想象用一行行的单位正方形铺满地面。用总面积除以每行的长。

hints.en: Which side is labelled, and which side has a question mark?
hints.zh: 哪条边标了长度？哪条边标了问号？

hints.en: Area ÷ length = breadth.
hints.zh: 面积 ÷ 长 = 宽。

hints.en: Work out 60 ÷ 12.

correct.en: Yes. 60 ÷ 12 = 5, so the breadth is 5 m.

say.en: 60 ÷ 2 − 12 treats the area as a perimeter. Look at the area note: divide by the length.
say.zh: 60 ÷ 2 − 12 是已知周长时的办法，这里给的是面积。要用面积除以长。

fallback.en: Not yet. Use the area note and the labelled length to find the side marked ?.
fallback.zh: 还没对。用面积和标出的长，求问号处的边长。

reveal.en: Area = length × breadth. 60 ÷ 12 = 5, so the missing breadth is 5 m.
reveal.zh: 面积 = 长 × 宽。60 ÷ 12 = 5，所以宽是 5 m。

prompt.en: A rectangle has perimeter 30 cm and length 11 cm. Find its breadth.
prompt.zh: 长方形周长 30 cm，长 11 cm。求宽。

guide.en: Half the perimeter is one length plus one breadth. Halve it, then subtract the known length.
guide.zh: 周长的一半是一条长加一条宽。先把周长除以 2，再减去已知的长。

hints.en: Look at the perimeter note: it measures all four sides.
hints.zh: 题目给的是周长，也就是四条边的总长。

hints.en: Find half the perimeter first.
hints.zh: 先求周长的一半。

hints.en: 30 ÷ 2 = 15. Now work out 15 − 11.

correct.en: Yes. 30 ÷ 2 − 11 = 4, so the breadth is 4 cm.

say.en: 30 − 11 gives the other three sides together. Look at the four sides: halve the perimeter before subtracting the length.
say.zh: 30 − 11 得到的是另外三条边的和。周长里有两条长、两条宽：先把周长除以 2，再减去长。

fallback.en: Not yet. Half the way round is one length and one breadth. Start there.
fallback.zh: 还没对。半圈是一条长加一条宽。先求半圈的长度。

reveal.en: Half of 30 cm is 15 cm. Subtract the length: 15 − 11 = 4 cm.
reveal.zh: 30 cm 的一半是 15 cm。减去长：15 − 11 = 4 cm。

prompt.en: A rectangle has perimeter 34 m and breadth 7 m. Find its length.
prompt.zh: 长方形周长 34 m，宽 7 m。求长。

guide.en: Half the perimeter is one length plus one breadth. Halve it, then subtract the known breadth.
guide.zh: 周长的一半是一条长加一条宽。先把周长除以 2，再减去已知的宽。

hints.en: Look at the perimeter note: it measures all four sides.
hints.zh: 题目给的是周长，也就是四条边的总长。

hints.en: Find half the perimeter first.
hints.zh: 先求周长的一半。

hints.en: 34 ÷ 2 = 17. Now work out 17 − 7.

correct.en: Yes. 34 ÷ 2 − 7 = 10, so the length is 10 m.

say.en: 34 − 7 gives the other three sides together. Look at the four sides: halve the perimeter before subtracting the breadth.
say.zh: 34 − 7 得到的是另外三条边的和。周长里有两条长、两条宽：先把周长除以 2，再减去宽。

fallback.en: Not yet. Half the way round is one length and one breadth. Start there.
fallback.zh: 还没对。半圈是一条长加一条宽。先求半圈的长度。

reveal.en: Half of 34 m is 17 m. Subtract the breadth: 17 − 7 = 10 m.
reveal.zh: 34 m 的一半是 17 m。减去宽：17 − 7 = 10 m。

prompt.en: Draw a rectangle with length 5 cm across and area 20 cm².
prompt.zh: 画一个横向长 5 cm、面积 20 cm² 的长方形。

guide.en: Find the breadth by dividing area by length. Drag the corner, or use the buttons, to set the length across and breadth up.
guide.zh: 先用面积除以长，求出宽。拖动角上的点或用按钮，把长设在横向，宽设在竖向。

hints.en: Keep the length across at 5 cm.
hints.zh: 横向的长要保持为 5 cm。

hints.en: How many rows of 5 squares cover 20 squares?
hints.zh: 每行 5 格，要几行才能铺满 20 格？

hints.en: Find the breadth using 20 ÷ 5.

correct.en: Yes. The length across is 5 cm, and 5 × 4 = 20, so the area is 20 cm².
correct.zh: 对。横向长 5 cm，5 × 4 = 20，所以面积是 20 cm²。

say.en: Your rectangle goes round 20 cm. The given 20 cm² is an area: keep the length at 5 cm and count the squares inside.
say.zh: 你画的长方形周长是 20 cm。题目给的 20 cm² 是面积：保持长 5 cm，数里面的格子。

fallback.en: Not yet. Check that the length across is 5 cm and that the inside covers 20 squares.
fallback.zh: 还没对。检查横向长是否是 5 cm，里面是否铺满 20 格。

reveal.en: 20 ÷ 5 = 4. Draw 5 cm across and 4 cm up: 5 × 4 = 20 cm².
reveal.zh: 20 ÷ 5 = 4。横向画 5 cm，竖向画 4 cm：5 × 4 = 20 cm²。

prompt.en: Draw a rectangle with length 8 m across and area 24 m².
prompt.zh: 画一个横向长 8 m、面积 24 m² 的长方形。

guide.en: Find the breadth by dividing area by length. Drag the corner, or use the buttons, to set the length across and breadth up.
guide.zh: 先用面积除以长，求出宽。拖动角上的点或用按钮，把长设在横向，宽设在竖向。

hints.en: Keep the length across at 8 m.
hints.zh: 横向的长要保持为 8 m。

hints.en: How many rows of 8 squares cover 24 squares?
hints.zh: 每行 8 格，要几行才能铺满 24 格？

hints.en: Find the breadth using 24 ÷ 8.

correct.en: Yes. The length across is 8 m, and 8 × 3 = 24, so the area is 24 m².
correct.zh: 对。横向长 8 m，8 × 3 = 24，所以面积是 24 m²。

say.en: Your rectangle goes round 24 m. The given 24 m² is an area: keep the length at 8 m and count the squares inside.
say.zh: 你画的长方形周长是 24 m。题目给的 24 m² 是面积：保持长 8 m，数里面的格子。

fallback.en: Not yet. Check that the length across is 8 m and that the inside covers 24 squares.
fallback.zh: 还没对。检查横向长是否是 8 m，里面是否铺满 24 格。

reveal.en: 24 ÷ 8 = 3. Draw 8 m across and 3 m up: 8 × 3 = 24 m².

prompt.en: Area is 60 cm² and length is 10 cm. Which gives the breadth?
prompt.zh: 面积 60 cm²，长 10 cm。哪一项求出了宽？

guide.en: Use the area note and the known length. The breadth must multiply with the length to make the area.
guide.zh: 用面积和已知的长来想。宽乘长，要等于面积。

hints.en: The note gives area, which covers the inside.
hints.zh: 题目给的是面积，是铺满里面的面。

hints.en: Divide the area by the length. The breadth is a length, so use cm.
hints.zh: 用面积除以长。宽是一段长度，单位用 cm。

correct.en: Yes. 60 ÷ 10 = 6 cm, because 10 × 6 = 60 cm².

say.en: Halving then subtracting is the perimeter method. Look at the area note: divide 60 by the length 10.
say.zh: 先除以 2 再减去长，是已知周长时的方法，这里给的是面积：用 60 除以长 10。

say.en: The number 6 gives the breadth, a length. Look at the side marked ?: use cm; cm² measures area.
say.zh: 6 对了，可宽是一段长度，单位要用 cm；cm² 是面积单位。

fallback.en: Not yet. Check both the area method and the unit for a side length.
fallback.zh: 还没对。检查求宽的方法和边长的单位。

reveal.en: Choose 60 ÷ 10 = 6 cm. Area ÷ length gives breadth, measured in cm.
reveal.zh: 选 60 ÷ 10 = 6 cm。面积除以长得到宽，单位是 cm。

prompt.en: Perimeter is 32 m and breadth is 4 m. Which gives the length?
prompt.zh: 周长 32 m，宽 4 m。哪一项求出了长？

guide.en: Half the distance round is one length and one breadth. Find that half, then subtract the known breadth.
guide.zh: 绕半圈是一条长加一条宽。先求半圈的长度，再减去已知的宽。

hints.en: The note gives the distance round all four sides.
hints.zh: 题目给的是四条边绕一圈的总长。

hints.en: Half the perimeter = length + breadth.
hints.zh: 周长的一半 = 长 + 宽。

hints.en: Find 32 ÷ 2, then take away 4.
hints.zh: 先算 32 ÷ 2，再减去 4。

correct.en: Yes. Half of 32 m is 16 m, and 16 − 4 = 12 m gives the length.
correct.zh: 对。32 m 的一半是 16 m，16 − 4 = 12 m，得到长。

say.en: Dividing by the breadth finds a length from area. Look at the perimeter note: halve 32 before subtracting 4.
say.zh: 用 32 除以宽，是已知面积时的方法，这里给的是周长：先把 32 除以 2，再减去 4。

say.en: 32 − 4 gives the other three sides together. Look at the pair of equal lengths: use half the perimeter first.
say.zh: 32 − 4 得到另外三条边的和。周长里有两条长、两条宽，要先求周长的一半。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find the distance along one length and one breadth first.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先求一条长加一条宽的长度。

reveal.en: Choose 32 ÷ 2 − 4 = 12 m. Half the perimeter is 16 m; subtracting the breadth leaves the length.
reveal.zh: 选 32 ÷ 2 − 4 = 12 m。周长的一半是 16 m，减去宽，就得到长。

caption.en: A square has a perimeter of 20 cm. Its four sides are equal.
caption.zh: 一个正方形周长 20 cm，四条边一样长。

caption.en: So each side is 20 ÷ 4 = 5 cm. Halving 20 gives 10, which is two sides, not one.
caption.zh: 所以每条边是 20 ÷ 4 = 5 cm。20 的一半是 10，那是两条边的长。

caption.en: Another square has an area of 36 cm². Which number times itself makes 36?
caption.zh: 另一个正方形面积 36 cm²。哪个数乘它自己得 36？

caption.en: Try squares: 5 × 5 = 25, 6 × 6 = 36. The side is 6 cm. 36 ÷ 4 = 9 does not work: a 9 cm square has an area of 81 cm².
caption.zh: 一个个试：5 × 5 = 25，6 × 6 = 36，边长是 6 cm。36 ÷ 4 = 9 不对：边长 9 cm 的正方形面积是 81 cm²。

keyFacts.en: Side of a square = perimeter ÷ 4.
keyFacts.zh: 正方形的边长 = 周长 ÷ 4。

keyFacts.en: From the area, find the number that times itself gives the area.
keyFacts.zh: 已知面积，找乘它自己得到面积的那个数。

prompt.en: A square tile has an area of 64 cm². How long is each side?
prompt.zh: 一块正方形瓷砖面积是 64 cm²。它的边长是多少？

guide.en: The area of a square is side × side. Find the number that times itself makes 64.
guide.zh: 正方形的面积 = 边长 × 边长。找一个数，它乘它自己得 64。

hints.en: Which number times itself is 64?
hints.zh: 哪个数乘它自己得 64？

hints.en: Try 7 × 7 and 8 × 8.

correct.en: Yes. 8 × 8 = 64: each side is 8 cm.

say.en: 64 ÷ 4 = 16 shares out a perimeter, not an area. A 16 cm square has an area of 256 cm². Find the number that times itself makes 64.
say.zh: 64 ÷ 4 = 16 是已知周长时的办法。边长 16 cm 的正方形面积是 256 cm²，不是 64 cm²。要找乘它自己得 64 的数。

fallback.en: Not yet. Try squares: which number times itself makes 64?
fallback.zh: 还没对。一个个试：哪个数乘它自己得 64？

reveal.en: 7 × 7 = 49 and 8 × 8 = 64, so the side is 8 cm.

prompt.en: A square garden has a perimeter of 28 m. How long is each side?
prompt.zh: 一个正方形花园的周长是 28 m。边长是多少？

guide.en: The fence goes round four equal sides. Share the perimeter equally among those four sides.
guide.zh: 围栏绕花园一圈，共有四条一样长的边。把周长平均分成四份。

hints.en: Look at the four sides of the garden.
hints.zh: 看看花园的四条边。

hints.en: Each side is one quarter of the perimeter.
hints.zh: 每条边是周长的四分之一。

hints.en: Work out 28 ÷ 4.

correct.en: Yes. 28 ÷ 4 = 7, so each side is 7 m.
correct.zh: 对。28 ÷ 4 = 7，所以边长是 7 m。

say.en: 28 ÷ 2 = 14 gives two sides together. Look at all four equal sides and divide the perimeter by 4.
say.zh: 28 ÷ 2 = 14 是两条边的总长。看看四条一样长的边，周长要除以 4。

fallback.en: Not yet. The 28 m goes all the way round four equal sides.
fallback.zh: 还没对。28 m 是绕四条相等的边一圈的总长。

reveal.en: The four equal sides total 28 m. 28 ÷ 4 = 7, so the side is 7 m.
reveal.zh: 四条相等的边共长 28 m。28 ÷ 4 = 7，所以边长是 7 m。

prompt.en: A square sheet of paper has a perimeter of 44 cm. Write its side with the unit.
prompt.zh: 一张正方形纸的周长是 44 cm。写出边长和单位。

guide.en: A square has four equal sides. Divide the perimeter by 4 and choose a length unit for one side.
guide.zh: 正方形的四条边一样长。周长除以 4，边长要用长度单位。

hints.en: The note gives the distance round the paper.
hints.zh: 图下给的是绕纸一圈的长度。

hints.en: Share 44 cm among four equal sides.
hints.zh: 把 44 cm 平均分给四条边。

hints.en: Calculate 44 ÷ 4, then choose cm.
hints.zh: 算出 44 ÷ 4，再选 cm。

correct.en: Yes. 44 ÷ 4 = 11. Each side is 11 cm, a length.
correct.zh: 对。44 ÷ 4 = 11。边长是 11 cm，用长度单位。

say.en: 44 ÷ 2 = 22 gives half the way round. Find one of the four equal sides by dividing by 4.
say.zh: 44 ÷ 2 = 22 是半圈的长度。求四条相等的边中的一条，要除以 4。

say.en: 11 is the side length. Look at the side: it is measured in cm; cm² measures the surface covered.
say.zh: 11 对了，可边长是一段长度，单位要用 cm；cm² 是量面积的单位。

fallback.en: Not yet. Divide the whole perimeter among four equal sides and use a length unit.
fallback.zh: 还没对。把整个周长平均分给四条边，再选长度单位。

reveal.en: 44 ÷ 4 = 11. One side is a length of 11 cm.
reveal.zh: 44 ÷ 4 = 11。一条边的长度是 11 cm。

prompt.en: The area of this square is 100 cm². How long is one side?
prompt.zh: 这个正方形的面积是 100 cm²。边长是多少？

guide.en: A square is covered by equal numbers of rows and squares in each row. Find the number that times itself makes the given area.
guide.zh: 正方形里，行数和每行的正方形个数相同。找一个数，乘它自己得到给出的面积。

hints.en: The note gives the area covered, in cm².
hints.zh: 图下给的是铺满的面积，单位是 cm²。

hints.en: Use side × side = 100.
hints.zh: 用边长 × 边长 = 100。

hints.en: Try 9 × 9, then 10 × 10.

correct.en: Yes. 10 × 10 = 100, so each side is 10 cm.

say.en: 100 ÷ 4 = 25 uses the rule for sharing a perimeter. Look at the area note: find a number that times itself makes 100.
say.zh: 100 ÷ 4 = 25 是已知周长时的办法，这里给的是面积。要找乘它自己得 100 的数。

fallback.en: Not yet. Multiply your side length by itself and check whether the area is 100 cm².
fallback.zh: 还没对。把你求出的边长乘它自己，看看面积是不是 100 cm²。

reveal.en: 9 × 9 = 81 and 10 × 10 = 100. The side is 10 cm.

prompt.en: A square bedroom floor covers 16 m². Write its side length with the unit.
prompt.zh: 一间正方形卧室的地面面积是 16 m²。写出边长和单位。

guide.en: The side multiplied by itself gives the floor area. Find that number, then choose the unit for a side length.
guide.zh: 边长乘边长得到地面面积。先找出这个数，再选边长的单位。

hints.en: You are finding a side of the floor.
hints.zh: 你要求的是地面的一条边。

hints.en: Find two equal factors of 16.
hints.zh: 找出两个相同的数，相乘得 16。

hints.en: Compare 3 × 3 with 4 × 4; the side is measured in m.
hints.zh: 比较 3 × 3 和 4 × 4；边长用 m 来量。

correct.en: Yes. 4 × 4 = 16, so the side length is 4 m.
correct.zh: 对。4 × 4 = 16，所以边长是 4 m。

say.en: 16 ÷ 2 = 8 does not undo side × side. An 8 m square covers 64 m². Look for the equal factors of 16.
say.zh: 16 ÷ 2 = 8 不对：边长 8 m 的正方形面积是 64 m²。要找两个相同的数，相乘得 16。

say.en: 4 is the side length, measured in m. Look at one edge of the floor; m² measures the surface covered.
say.zh: 4 对了，可边长是一段长度，单位要用 m；m² 是量面积的单位。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find a number that times itself gives 16, and use a length unit.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找一个数，乘它自己得 16，再用长度单位。

reveal.en: 4 × 4 = 16. The floor covers 16 m² and each side is 4 m.
reveal.zh: 4 × 4 = 16。地面面积是 16 m²，边长是 4 m。

prompt.en: A square has a perimeter of 24 cm. Choose its area.
prompt.zh: 一个正方形的周长是 24 cm。选出它的面积。

guide.en: First share the perimeter among four equal sides. Then multiply the side by itself to find the area covered.
guide.zh: 先把周长平均分给四条边，再用边长乘边长，求铺满的面积。

hints.en: The note gives perimeter; the choices give area.
hints.zh: 图下给的是周长，选项里是面积。

hints.en: Find the side using 24 ÷ 4.
hints.zh: 用 24 ÷ 4 求边长。

hints.en: The side is 6 cm; work out 6 × 6.
hints.zh: 边长是 6 cm，算出 6 × 6。

correct.en: Yes. 24 ÷ 4 = 6 cm, and 6 × 6 = 36 cm².

say.en: 24 ÷ 2 = 12 gives two sides together. Squaring 12 gives 144. Look at the four equal sides and use 24 ÷ 4 before multiplying.
say.zh: 24 ÷ 2 = 12 是两条边的总长，用它算出的是 144。周长要平均分给四条边：先算 24 ÷ 4，再相乘。

say.en: 6 + 6 = 12 adds two side lengths. Look at the surface covered: use 6 × 6 to count the squares.
say.zh: 6 + 6 = 12 是两条边的长度相加。看看铺满的面，用 6 × 6 求正方形个数。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find one side from the perimeter, then multiply that side by itself.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先从周长求一条边，再把边长乘它自己。

reveal.en: The side is 24 ÷ 4 = 6 cm. Its area is 6 × 6 = 36 cm².
reveal.zh: 边长是 24 ÷ 4 = 6 cm。面积是 6 × 6 = 36 cm²。

prompt.en: A square garden fence goes round 36 m. What area does the garden cover?
prompt.zh: 正方形花园的围栏绕一圈长 36 m。花园面积是多少？

guide.en: The fence length is the perimeter of four equal sides. Find one side, then use side × side for the garden area.
guide.zh: 围栏总长是四条相等的边组成的周长。先求边长，再用边长 × 边长求花园面积。

hints.en: The fence goes round the garden; area covers the inside.
hints.zh: 围栏绕花园一圈；面积是里面铺满的面。

hints.en: Divide the fence length by 4 to find one side.
hints.zh: 把围栏总长除以 4，求一条边。

hints.en: 36 ÷ 4 = 9; now multiply 9 by itself.
hints.zh: 36 ÷ 4 = 9，再把 9 乘它自己。

correct.en: Yes. The side is 36 ÷ 4 = 9 m. The garden covers 9 × 9 = 81 m².
correct.zh: 对。边长是 36 ÷ 4 = 9 m。花园面积是 9 × 9 = 81 m²。

say.en: 36 m measures the fence round the garden. Changing the unit to m² does not find the area. Look inside: find the side, then multiply it by itself.
say.zh: 36 m 是绕花园一圈的围栏长度，不是面积，改写成 m² 也不对。先求边长，再把边长乘它自己。

say.en: 36 ÷ 2 = 18 gives two sides together, and 18 × 18 gives 324. Look at all four equal sides: divide 36 by 4 first.
say.zh: 36 ÷ 2 = 18 是两条边的总长，18 × 18 得 324。四条边一样长，要先把 36 除以 4。

fallback.en: Not yet. Share the perimeter among four sides, then use side × side for area.
fallback.zh: 还没对。把周长平均分给四条边，再用边长 × 边长求面积。

reveal.en: 36 ÷ 4 = 9 m for one side. 9 × 9 = 81 m².

prompt.en: Draw a square with an area of 36 cm².
prompt.zh: 画一个面积是 36 cm² 的正方形。

guide.en: Each grid cell covers 1 cm². Find equal numbers of cells across and up whose product is 36, then drag the corner to draw the square.
guide.zh: 每格的面积是 1 cm²。横着和竖着的格数要相同，相乘得 36，再拖动角点画出正方形。

hints.en: Your drawing needs four equal sides.
hints.zh: 你画的图形要有四条相等的边。

hints.en: Choose the same number of cells across and up, with a product of 36.
hints.zh: 横着和竖着取相同的格数，相乘要得 36。

hints.en: 6 × 6 = 36; drag to 6 cells across and 6 up.
hints.zh: 6 × 6 = 36，拖到横着 6 格、竖着 6 格的位置。

correct.en: Yes. A 6 cm by 6 cm square covers 6 × 6 = 36 cm².
correct.zh: 对。边长 6 cm 的正方形面积是 6 × 6 = 36 cm²。

say.en: 36 ÷ 4 = 9 treats the area as a perimeter. Your 9 by 9 square covers 81 cm². Look for a side that times itself makes 36.
say.zh: 36 ÷ 4 = 9 把面积当成了周长。你画的 9 × 9 正方形面积是 81 cm²。找乘它自己得 36 的边长。

fallback.en: Not yet. Check that the sides are equal and the number of cells across times the number up is 36.
fallback.zh: 还没对。检查边长是否相等，横着的格数乘竖着的格数是不是 36。

reveal.en: Draw 6 cells across and 6 up. Its four sides are 6 cm and its area is 6 × 6 = 36 cm².
reveal.zh: 画横着 6 格、竖着 6 格的正方形。四条边各长 6 cm，面积是 6 × 6 = 36 cm²。

prompt.en: Draw a square that covers 16 m² on this grid.
prompt.zh: 在方格上画一个面积是 16 m² 的正方形。

guide.en: Each cell covers 1 m². Use the same number of cells across and up so that they cover 16 m² altogether.
guide.zh: 每格的面积是 1 m²。横着和竖着的格数要相同，合起来铺满 16 m²。

hints.en: Check the unit square in the corner.
hints.zh: 看看角落标出的单位正方形。

hints.en: For a square, side × side must give 16.
hints.zh: 正方形的边长 × 边长要得 16。

hints.en: 4 × 4 = 16; draw four cells across and four up.
hints.zh: 4 × 4 = 16，画横着 4 格、竖着 4 格的正方形。

correct.en: Yes. Four cells across and four up cover 16 m², with four equal 4 m sides.
correct.zh: 对。横着 4 格、竖着 4 格铺满 16 m²，四条边各长 4 m。

say.en: 16 ÷ 2 = 8 does not find the side from the area. Your 8 by 8 square covers 64 m². Look for equal factors of 16.
say.zh: 16 ÷ 2 = 8 不能从面积求出边长。你画的 8 × 8 正方形面积是 64 m²。找两个相同的数，相乘得 16。

say.en: A 3 by 5 rectangle has a perimeter of 16 m, but covers 15 m² and has unequal adjacent sides. Look at the area note and draw equal sides whose product is 16.
say.zh: 3 × 5 的长方形周长是 16 m，面积却是 15 m²，而且相邻的两条边不相等。要画四条边相等的正方形，让边长乘边长得 16。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count the cells across and up: they must be equal and their product must be 16.
fallback.zh: 还没对。数横着和竖着的格数：两者要相同，相乘要得 16。

reveal.en: Draw a 4 by 4 square. Each side is 4 m, and 4 × 4 = 16 m².
reveal.zh: 画一个 4 × 4 的正方形。边长是 4 m，4 × 4 = 16 m²。

caption.en: The floor plan of an L-shaped room. It is not a rectangle, so length × breadth does not work straight away.
caption.zh: 一个 L 形房间的平面图。它不是长方形，不能直接用长 × 宽。

caption.en: Cut it into two rectangles: 5 m by 6 m and 3 m by 4 m. 30 + 12 = 42 m².
caption.zh: 切成两个长方形：5 m × 6 m 和 3 m × 4 m。30 + 12 = 42 m²。

caption.en: Cut it the other way and the pieces change, but the total stays the same: 32 + 10 = 42 m².
caption.zh: 换一种切法，两块变了，总面积不变：32 + 10 = 42 m²。

caption.en: Or start from the whole 8 m by 6 m rectangle and take away the missing corner: 48 − 6 = 42 m². Pieces that overlap would be counted twice.
caption.zh: 也可以先算 8 m × 6 m 的大长方形，再减去缺的角：48 − 6 = 42 m²。两块重叠的话，重叠的部分就算了两次。

keyFacts.en: Cut a composite figure into rectangles and add their areas.
keyFacts.zh: 把组合图形切成长方形，面积相加。

keyFacts.en: Or take the missing piece away from a bigger rectangle.
keyFacts.zh: 或者从大长方形里减去缺的那块。

prompt.en: Cut the floor plan into two rectangles, then find its area.
prompt.zh: 把平面图切成两个长方形，再求它的面积。

guide.en: Tap a grid line that splits the figure into two rectangles. Find the area of each piece, then add them.
guide.zh: 点一条把图形分成两个长方形的格线。分别求出两块的面积，再加起来。

hints.en: Try a cut up and down where the step is.
hints.zh: 在台阶那里试着竖着切一刀。

hints.en: A cut after 5 columns gives 5 m × 7 m and 4 m × 4 m.
hints.zh: 在第 5 列后切开，得到 5 m × 7 m 和 4 m × 4 m。

correct.en: Yes. The two rectangles have areas that add up to 51 m².
correct.zh: 对。两个长方形的面积加起来是 51 m²。

say.en: 35 + 36 counts the corner where the two pieces overlap twice. Use pieces that do not overlap: cut the figure, then add.
say.zh: 35 + 36 把两块重叠的那个角算了两次。用不重叠的两块：先切开，再相加。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find the area of each piece of your cut, then add.
fallback.zh: 还没对。分别求出你切出的两块的面积，再相加。

reveal.en: Cut after 5 columns: 5 × 7 = 35 and 4 × 4 = 16, 35 + 16 = 51 m². Cut across instead: 9 × 4 = 36 and 5 × 3 = 15, also 51 m².

prompt.en: Cut this L shape into two rectangles, then find its area.
prompt.zh: 把这个 L 形切成两个长方形，再求面积。

guide.en: Cut along a grid line through the inside corner. Multiply the length by the breadth of each piece, then add the areas.
guide.zh: 沿经过内角的格线切开。分别用长乘宽求面积，再相加。

hints.en: Look at the corner where the two arms meet.
hints.zh: 先看两部分交接处的内角。

hints.en: A vertical cut after 4 columns leaves two rectangles.
hints.zh: 在第 4 列后竖着切，得到两个长方形。

hints.en: The pieces are 4 cm by 6 cm and 6 cm by 2 cm.
hints.zh: 两块分别是 4 cm × 6 cm 和 6 cm × 2 cm。

correct.en: Yes. 24 + 12 = 36 cm² covers the whole shape once.
correct.zh: 对。24 + 12 = 36 cm²，整个图形的每一部分都算一次。

say.en: 24 + 20 counts the 4 cm by 2 cm corner twice. Look at the corner shared by the full-height column and the bottom row.
say.zh: 24 + 20 把 4 cm × 2 cm 的角算了两次。看看通高的长方形和底部长方形重叠的角。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find the area of each rectangle from your cut, then add.
fallback.zh: 还没对。分别求出切开的两个长方形的面积，再相加。

reveal.en: Cut after 4 columns: 4 × 6 = 24 and 6 × 2 = 12. The area is 24 + 12 = 36 cm².

prompt.en: Cut this L-shaped floor plan into two rectangles and find its area.
prompt.zh: 把这个 L 形平面图切成两个长方形，求面积。

guide.en: Look for a grid line through the inside corner that leaves two rectangles. Find their areas separately and add.
guide.zh: 找经过内角的格线，让两块都是长方形。分别求面积，再相加。

hints.en: The tall part is on the right.
hints.zh: 高的部分在右边。

hints.en: Cut vertically after 3 columns.
hints.zh: 在第 3 列后竖着切。

hints.en: The left piece is 3 m by 4 m; the right piece is 5 m by 9 m.
hints.zh: 左块是 3 m × 4 m，右块是 5 m × 9 m。

correct.en: Yes. 12 + 45 = 57 m²; the pieces cover the floor plan once.
correct.zh: 对。12 + 45 = 57 m²，两块刚好铺满平面图。

say.en: 45 + 32 counts the bottom-right corner twice. Separate the tall right part from the short left part.
say.zh: 45 + 32 把右下角算了两次。把右边高的部分和左边矮的部分切开。

fallback.en: Not yet. Check that the two rectangles from your cut cover each part once.
fallback.zh: 还没对。检查切出的两块是否把每一部分都算了一次。

reveal.en: Cut after 3 columns: the left piece is 3 × 4 = 12 m² and the right piece is 5 × 9 = 45 m². 12 + 45 = 57 m².

prompt.en: Cut this L shape into two rectangles and add their areas.
prompt.zh: 把这个 L 形切成两个长方形，面积相加。

guide.en: Choose a cut through the inside corner. Count each rectangle’s length and breadth, then multiply and add.
guide.zh: 选经过内角的切线。数出每块的长和宽，分别相乘，再相加。

hints.en: Look below the top strip at the inside corner.
hints.zh: 看看上方横条下的内角。

hints.en: Cut vertically after 8 columns.
hints.zh: 在第 8 列后竖着切。

hints.en: The left piece is 8 m by 2 m; the right piece is 4 m by 10 m.
hints.zh: 左块是 8 m × 2 m，右块是 4 m × 10 m。

correct.en: Yes. 16 + 40 = 56 m²; neither piece overlaps the other.
correct.zh: 对。16 + 40 = 56 m²，两块没有重叠。

say.en: 40 + 24 includes the top-right 4 m by 2 m corner twice. Look at where the full-height right part meets the full top strip.
say.zh: 40 + 24 把右上角 4 m × 2 m 的部分算了两次。看看右边通高的部分与整条上方横条重叠的地方。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find the two areas using the pieces made by your cut.
fallback.zh: 还没对。按你切出的两块分别求面积。

reveal.en: Cut after 8 columns: 8 × 2 = 16 and 4 × 10 = 40. The total is 16 + 40 = 56 m².

prompt.en: Find the unlabelled sides, then the area of this L-shaped room.
prompt.zh: 先求没标的边，再求这个 L 形房间的面积。

guide.en: Find the missing horizontal and vertical lengths by subtraction. Split into two rectangles, or subtract the missing corner from the whole rectangle.
guide.zh: 先用减法求没标的横边和竖边。再切成两个长方形相加，或从大长方形减去缺角。

hints.en: Compare the whole bottom and left sides with the shorter sides.
hints.zh: 把底边和左边的总长度与短边比较。

hints.en: Use 14 − 8 for the missing horizontal side and 9 − 5 for the vertical side.
hints.zh: 没标的横边算 14 − 8，竖边算 9 − 5。

hints.en: Subtract the missing 6 m by 4 m corner from a 14 m by 9 m rectangle.
hints.zh: 从 14 m × 9 m 的长方形减去缺的 6 m × 4 m 的角。

correct.en: Yes. 14 × 9 − 6 × 4 = 102 m² leaves just the room.
correct.zh: 对。14 × 9 − 6 × 4 = 102 m²，剩下的正好是房间。

say.en: 126 m² covers the whole 14 m by 9 m rectangle, including the missing top-right corner. Find that corner’s sides and subtract its area.
say.zh: 126 m² 是整个 14 m × 9 m 长方形的面积，包含缺的右上角。先求缺角的两条边，再减去它的面积。

say.en: 46 m is the distance round the room. To find the area it covers, multiply the sides of each rectangle and add.
say.zh: 46 m 是绕房间一圈的长度。求它铺满的面积，要分别用长乘宽再相加。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find both unlabelled lengths before calculating the areas.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先求出两条没标的边，再算面积。

reveal.en: The unlabelled sides are 14 − 8 = 6 m and 9 − 5 = 4 m. 14 × 9 − 6 × 4 = 126 − 24 = 102 m².

prompt.en: Find the unlabelled lengths, then give the area and its unit.
prompt.zh: 先求没标的长度，再写面积和单位。

guide.en: Use the total lengths to find the missing sides of the joined rectangles. Multiply for each piece and add the areas in square centimetres.
guide.zh: 用总长度求出没标的边。两块的面积分别相乘再相加，单位用平方厘米。

hints.en: Look at the dashed join between the two rectangles.
hints.zh: 先看两个长方形之间的虚线。

hints.en: The upper rectangle’s breadth is 11 − 4; the left step is 13 − 8.
hints.zh: 上方长方形的宽是 11 − 4；左边台阶的横边是 13 − 8。

hints.en: Add 13 × 4 and 8 × 7, then choose the area unit.
hints.zh: 把 13 × 4 与 8 × 7 相加，再选面积单位。

correct.en: Yes. 52 + 56 = 108 cm² covers the two joined rectangles once.
correct.zh: 对。52 + 56 = 108 cm²，拼合的两个长方形各算一次。

say.en: 143 cm² is the whole 13 cm by 11 cm box. The top-left 5 cm by 7 cm corner is missing; leave its area out.
say.zh: 143 cm² 是整个 13 cm × 11 cm 外框的面积。左上角缺了 5 cm × 7 cm，要去掉这块面积。

say.en: 108 is the area number, but cm measures a length. Look at the unit chips and choose cm² for the surface covered.
say.zh: 面积数值 108 对了，但 cm 是长度单位。看看单位选项，铺满的面要用 cm²。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find the upper rectangle’s unlabelled breadth, then add the two areas and check the unit.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先求上方长方形没标的宽，再把两块面积相加，检查单位。

reveal.en: The unlabelled lengths are 11 − 4 = 7 cm and 13 − 8 = 5 cm. The pieces cover 13 × 4 + 8 × 7 = 52 + 56 = 108 cm².

prompt.en: Find the missing side lengths, then the area of this composite figure.
prompt.zh: 先求没标的边长，再求这个组合图形的面积。

guide.en: Subtract the shorter lengths from the whole lengths. Use the dashed join to identify two rectangles and add the areas they cover.
guide.zh: 用总长度减去短边，求出没标的边。沿虚线看出两个长方形，再把它们铺满的面积相加。

hints.en: The short rectangle joins the tall rectangle at the top.
hints.zh: 矮的长方形接在高的长方形上方。

hints.en: Use 16 − 7 for the right piece’s length and 12 − 4 for the lower vertical side.
hints.zh: 右块的长算 16 − 7；下方没标的竖边算 12 − 4。

hints.en: Add the areas 7 × 12 and 9 × 4.
hints.zh: 把 7 × 12 和 9 × 4 的面积相加。

correct.en: Yes. 84 + 36 = 120 m² covers both pieces without overlap.
correct.zh: 对。84 + 36 = 120 m²，两块没有重叠，刚好铺满图形。

say.en: 192 m² includes the missing bottom-right corner of the 16 m by 12 m box. Use the two rectangles shown instead.
say.zh: 192 m² 包含 16 m × 12 m 外框里缺的右下角。改用图中的两个长方形。

say.en: 56 m goes round the outside. Area covers the inside, so find the two products from the rectangles’ side lengths.
say.zh: 56 m 是绕外面一圈的长度。面积铺满里面，要用两个长方形的边长分别相乘。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find the unlabelled lengths, then multiply for each rectangle and add.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先求没标的长度，再分别求两个长方形的面积并相加。

reveal.en: The missing lengths are 16 − 7 = 9 m and 12 − 4 = 8 m. The area is 7 × 12 + 9 × 4 = 84 + 36 = 120 m².

prompt.en: Which method splits this L shape into two rectangles to find its area?
prompt.zh: 哪种方法把 L 形分成两个长方形来求面积？

guide.en: Trace each proposed rectangle on the grid. The two pieces must cover the shape once, with no overlapping corner.
guide.zh: 在方格上看看每个方法中的两块。两块要刚好铺满图形，角落不能重叠。

text.en: Add a 3 cm by 7 cm rectangle and a 10 cm by 4 cm rectangle.
text.zh: 把 3 cm × 7 cm 与 10 cm × 4 cm 的长方形面积相加。

text.en: Cut vertically after 3 columns; add the areas of the 3 cm by 7 cm and 7 cm by 4 cm pieces.
text.zh: 在第 3 列后竖着切，把 3 cm × 7 cm 与 7 cm × 4 cm 两块的面积相加。

hints.en: Look at the bottom-left corner included in both full arms.
hints.zh: 看看两条完整部分共有的左下角。

hints.en: A vertical cut through the inside corner keeps the pieces separate.
hints.zh: 经过内角竖着切，两块就不会重叠。

correct.en: Yes. The vertical cut gives two rectangles that cover the L shape once.
correct.zh: 对。竖着切出的两个长方形刚好铺满 L 形，每一部分都算一次。

say.en: The 3 cm by 7 cm and 10 cm by 4 cm rectangles overlap at the bottom-left corner. Use the cut so that each square is counted once.
say.zh: 3 cm × 7 cm 与 10 cm × 4 cm 两块在左下角重叠。沿切线分开，让每个正方形只算一次。

fallback.en: Not yet. Check whether the proposed rectangles share any squares.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看方法中的两个长方形有没有共有的格子。

reveal.en: Cut vertically after 3 columns: 3 × 7 = 21 and 7 × 4 = 28. The separate pieces give 21 + 28 = 49 cm².

prompt.en: Which number sentence finds the area of this composite figure?
prompt.zh: 哪个算式能求出这个组合图形的面积？

guide.en: Look for a sentence that covers the inside with separate rectangles. Check that the unlabelled breadth is found from the marked lengths.
guide.zh: 找用不重叠的长方形铺满里面的算式。检查没标的宽是否由已知长度求出。

hints.en: Imagine a horizontal cut through the inside corner.
hints.zh: 想一想经过内角横着切。

hints.en: The bottom piece is 15 cm by 4 cm. The upper piece has breadth 10 − 4.
hints.zh: 下方是 15 cm × 4 cm，上方的宽是 10 − 4。

correct.en: Yes. 15 × 4 + 9 × (10 − 4) counts the bottom and upper pieces separately.
correct.zh: 对。15 × 4 + 9 × (10 − 4) 分别计算下方和上方两块的面积。

say.en: 9 × 10 and 15 × 4 both include the bottom-left 9 cm by 4 cm corner. Use only 10 − 4 for the upper piece’s breadth.
say.zh: 9 × 10 和 15 × 4 都包含左下角 9 cm × 4 cm 的部分。上方那块的宽只用 10 − 4。

say.en: 2 × (15 + 10) finds the distance round the L shape, 50 cm. Look for products that cover the inside in cm².
say.zh: 2 × (15 + 10) 求绕 L 形一圈的长度，是 50 cm。找用乘法求铺满里面的面积的算式，单位是 cm²。

fallback.en: Not yet. Check which sentence counts every part of the surface once.
fallback.zh: 还没对。检查哪个算式把里面的每一部分都算了一次。

reveal.en: The upper breadth is 10 − 4 = 6 cm. A horizontal cut gives 15 × 4 + 9 × 6 = 60 + 54 = 114 cm².

prompt.en: Find the missing corner’s sides, then the area of this L shape.
prompt.zh: 先求缺角的边长，再求这个 L 形的面积。

guide.en: Imagine completing the shape to one whole rectangle. Find both sides of the missing corner by subtraction, then subtract its area from the whole area.
guide.zh: 想象把图形补成一个大长方形。先用减法求缺角的两条边，再从总面积减去缺角的面积。

hints.en: The missing corner is at the top left.
hints.zh: 缺的角在左上方。

hints.en: Its sides are 20 − 6 and 13 − 5.
hints.zh: 缺角的两条边是 20 − 6 和 13 − 5。

hints.en: Use 20 × 13 − 14 × 8 and choose square metres.

correct.en: Yes. 260 − 112 = 148 m² removes just the missing corner.
correct.zh: 对。260 − 112 = 148 m²，减去的正好是缺角。

say.en: 260 m² covers the whole rectangle, including the top-left gap. Find the gap’s two sides from the labelled lengths and subtract its area.
say.zh: 260 m² 是整个大长方形的面积，包含左上角缺的部分。用标出的长度求缺角的两条边，再减去它的面积。

say.en: 148 is the area number, but m is a length unit. Look at the unit choices: area uses m².
say.zh: 面积数值 148 对了，但 m 是长度单位。看看单位选项：面积要用 m²。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find both missing corner lengths, subtract its area, and check the unit.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先求缺角的两条边，再减去它的面积，检查单位。

caption.en: Two squares with sides of 4 cm. Each has a perimeter of 16 cm.
caption.zh: 两个边长 4 cm 的正方形，周长各是 16 cm。

caption.en: Push them together into one figure. The sides where they touch are now inside it.
caption.zh: 把它们推到一起，拼成一个图形。贴在一起的两条边到了里面。

caption.en: Walk round the outside only: 24 cm, not 16 + 16 = 32. The two touching sides, 4 cm each, are no longer on the edge.
caption.zh: 只走外面一圈：24 cm，不是 16 + 16 = 32。贴在一起的两条 4 cm 的边，已经不在外面了。

caption.en: The L-shaped room: find the missing sides first, then walk round all six. The perimeter is 28 m.
caption.zh: 再看 L 形房间：先求出没标的边，再把六条边走一圈。周长是 28 m。

keyFacts.en: Only the outside edge counts.
keyFacts.zh: 只算外面一圈。

keyFacts.en: Find missing sides first.
keyFacts.zh: 先求出没标的边。

prompt.en: Two hawker tables, each 6 m by 3 m, are pushed together end to end. What is the perimeter now?
prompt.zh: 两张 6 m × 3 m 的长桌首尾相接拼在一起。现在的周长是多少？

guide.en: The sides where the tables touch are now inside. Walk round the outside of the new shape only.
guide.zh: 两张桌子贴在一起的边到了里面。只走新图形外面一圈。

hints.en: What shape do the two tables make together?
hints.zh: 两张桌子拼成了什么形状？

hints.en: A rectangle 12 m long and 3 m wide.
hints.zh: 一个长 12 m、宽 3 m 的长方形。

correct.en: Yes. 12 + 3 + 12 + 3 = 30: the perimeter is 30 m.

say.en: 18 + 18 = 36 counts the two sides where the tables touch. Those are inside now: walk round the outside only.
say.zh: 18 + 18 = 36 把两张桌子贴着的边也算了。那两条边已经在里面了，只走外面一圈。

fallback.en: Not yet. Walk round the outside of the joined tables once.
fallback.zh: 还没对。绕拼好的桌子外面走一圈。

reveal.en: Together they make a 12 m by 3 m rectangle: 2 × (12 + 3) = 30 m.
reveal.zh: 拼起来是长 12 m、宽 3 m 的长方形：2 × (12 + 3) = 30 m。

prompt.en: Two rectangular panels are joined as shown. What is the perimeter of the whole figure?
prompt.zh: 两个长方形板拼成图中的组合图形。周长是多少？

guide.en: Look at the outside of the joined panels. Use the two top lengths to find the total length, then add all four outside sides.
guide.zh: 看拼好后外面一圈。先把上方两段相加求出总长，再把外面的四条边加起来。

hints.en: Find the dashed join and the outside edge.
hints.zh: 找出里面的虚线接缝和外面一圈。

hints.en: The total length is 7 + 5 cm; the breadth is 4 cm.
hints.zh: 总长是 7 + 5 cm，宽是 4 cm。

correct.en: Yes. The outside has two 12 cm sides and two 4 cm sides, giving 32 cm.
correct.zh: 对。外面有两条 12 cm 的边和两条 4 cm 的边，周长是 32 cm。

say.en: 22 + 18 = 40 adds both panels’ perimeters and includes the two touching 4 cm sides. Look at the outside of the joined figure.
say.zh: 22 + 18 = 40 把两块板贴着的两条 4 cm 边也算了。看拼好后外面一圈。

fallback.en: Not yet. Follow the outside edge back to your starting point and add each outside side once.
fallback.zh: 还没对。沿外面一圈回到起点，每条外边加一次。

reveal.en: The length is 7 + 5 = 12 cm. The perimeter is 12 + 4 + 12 + 4 = 32 cm; the join is inside.
reveal.zh: 总长是 7 + 5 = 12 cm。周长是 12 + 4 + 12 + 4 = 32 cm，接缝在里面。

prompt.en: Find the perimeter of this L-shaped floor plan made from two rectangles.
prompt.zh: 这个 L 形平面图由两个长方形拼成。求它的周长。

guide.en: You can follow six sides around the floor plan. The dashed join stays inside, so add only the outside lengths.
guide.zh: 你可以沿平面图的六条边绕一圈。虚线接缝在里面，只把外面的边长加起来。

hints.en: Start at a corner on the outside.
hints.zh: 从外面的一个角开始。

hints.en: Keep following the outside past the inward corner.
hints.zh: 经过凹进去的角，继续沿外边走。

correct.en: Yes. All six outside sides add up to 42 m; the touching sides stay inside.
correct.zh: 对。外面的六条边加起来是 42 m，贴在一起的边在里面。

say.en: 26 + 22 = 48 includes the touching 3 m side of each rectangle. Follow the six outside sides instead.
say.zh: 26 + 22 = 48 包含两个长方形贴着的两条 3 m 边。沿外面的六条边走一圈。

fallback.en: Not yet. Trace the six outside sides with your eyes and use each length once.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看着外面的六条边绕一圈，每个边长用一次。

reveal.en: The perimeter is 12 + 3 + 8 + 6 + 4 + 9 = 42 m. Adding the two rectangles’ perimeters gives 48 m, then removing both touching 3 m sides gives 42 m.
reveal.zh: 周长是 12 + 3 + 8 + 6 + 4 + 9 = 42 m。两个长方形的周长之和是 48 m，减去贴着的两条 3 m 边，也得 42 m。

prompt.en: How long is a fence going once round this L-shaped garden?
prompt.zh: 围栏绕这个 L 形花园一圈，需要多长？

guide.en: Two sides of the garden have no length label. Find each using the total distance across or up, then add all six sides.
guide.zh: 花园有两条边没标长度。用横向和竖向的总长度求出它们，再把六条边加起来。

hints.en: Look at the two sides beside the inward corner.
hints.zh: 看凹进去的角旁边两条没标长度的边。

hints.en: Across, use 14 − 6. Up, use 10 − 4.
The unlabelled sides are 8 m and 6 m. Add all six sides.
hints.zh: 没标的边是 8 m 和 6 m。把六条边加起来。

correct.en: Yes. Including the 8 m and 6 m sides gives a perimeter of 48 m.
correct.zh: 对。把 8 m 和 6 m 的两条边也加上，周长是 48 m。

say.en: 14 + 10 + 6 + 4 = 34 adds only the labelled sides. Find the two unlabelled sides at the inward corner.
say.zh: 14 + 10 + 6 + 4 = 34 只加了标出的边。求出凹角旁边两条没标的边。

fallback.en: Not yet. Walk round the garden and check that every side has a length in your sum.
fallback.zh: 还没对。绕花园一圈，检查每条边的长度是否都加上了。

reveal.en: The unlabelled sides are 14 − 6 = 8 m and 10 − 4 = 6 m. The fence length is 14 + 4 + 8 + 6 + 6 + 10 = 48 m.

prompt.en: Find the perimeter of the U-shaped figure made from three rectangles. Choose the unit too.
prompt.zh: 求三个长方形拼成的 U 形图形的周长，并选单位。

guide.en: Follow the edge down into the recess and back out. You need every outside length, including the three sides of the recess, and a length unit.
guide.zh: 沿边走进凹口，再走出来。把外面一圈所有边长加起来，包括凹口的三条边，并选长度单位。

hints.en: Locate the three sides of the recess and the two dashed joins.
hints.zh: 找出凹口的三条边和里面的两条虚线接缝。

hints.en: Add the eight outside sides; leave the dashed joins out.
hints.zh: 把外面的八条边相加，虚线接缝不计入周长。

hints.en: Use 15 + 10 + 4 + 7 + 7 + 7 + 4 + 10, then choose m.

correct.en: Yes. The edge goes round the recess too, giving 64 m. Perimeter uses a length unit.
correct.zh: 对。外边也绕过凹口，周长是 64 m。周长用长度单位。

say.en: 36 + 22 + 22 = 80 includes both sides of each 4 m join. Follow the outline, including the recess, and leave out the joins.
say.zh: 36 + 22 + 22 = 80 把每条 4 m 接缝的两侧也算了。沿轮廓绕过凹口，接缝不计入周长。

say.en: You found the distance round the edge, so use m. m² measures the surface covered by a figure.
say.zh: 你求的是绕外边一圈的长度，单位要用 m；m² 是量铺满的面积的单位。

fallback.en: Not yet. Follow every outside side through the recess, then check the length unit.
fallback.zh: 还没对。沿外边经过凹口走一圈，再检查长度单位。

reveal.en: The perimeter is 15 + 10 + 4 + 7 + 7 + 7 + 4 + 10 = 64 m. The recessed sides belong to the outline; the dashed joins do not.
reveal.zh: 周长是 15 + 10 + 4 + 7 + 7 + 7 + 4 + 10 = 64 m。凹口的边属于外面一圈，虚线接缝不计入周长。

prompt.en: Trace the outside of the joined rectangles, then write the perimeter.
prompt.zh: 描出拼好的长方形外面一圈，再写周长。

guide.en: Tap each small side on the outside once. Follow the inward corner and leave the dashed join inside untouched, then write the distance round.
guide.zh: 把外面一圈的每一小段点一次。沿凹角走，里面的虚线接缝不用点，再写绕一圈的长度。

hints.en: Start on the outside, away from the dashed join.
hints.zh: 从外边开始，留意里面的虚线接缝。

hints.en: Count the grid segments along all six outside sides.
hints.zh: 数外面六条边上的小线段。

hints.en: The six lengths are 7, 2, 4, 4, 3 and 6 cm.
hints.zh: 六条边长是 7、2、4、4、3 和 6 cm。

correct.en: Yes. You traced only the outside, and its 26 unit segments give 26 cm.
correct.zh: 对。你只描了外面一圈，共 26 小段，周长是 26 cm。

say.en: 18 + 12 = 30 adds the two rectangles’ perimeters and counts the touching 2 cm sides too. Count only the traced outside sides.
say.zh: 18 + 12 = 30 把两个长方形贴着的两条 2 cm 边也算了。只数你描出的外边。

say.en: You included a segment inside the figure. Perimeter follows the outside: remove the inside segment and look round the outline.
say.zh: 你点到了图形里面的一小段。周长沿外面一圈走，去掉里面那一段，再检查轮廓。

fallback.en: Not yet. Check that every outside segment is traced once, then write their total length.
fallback.zh: 还没对。检查外面每一小段都描了一次，再写总长度。

reveal.en: The outside lengths are 7 + 2 + 4 + 4 + 3 + 6 = 26 cm. The join is inside and adds no length to the perimeter.
reveal.zh: 外面的边长是 7 + 2 + 4 + 4 + 3 + 6 = 26 cm。接缝在里面，不计入周长。

prompt.en: Trace round the three joined rectangles, then write the perimeter.
prompt.zh: 沿三个拼好的长方形描一圈，再写周长。

guide.en: Tap the small sides along the stepped outside edge. You can go round the whole figure without crossing either dashed join.
guide.zh: 沿台阶形的外边点出每一小段。绕整个图形一圈时，不用经过里面的虚线接缝。

hints.en: Follow the steps along the top of the figure.
hints.zh: 沿图形上方的台阶边走。

hints.en: Add each outside segment once, including the short vertical steps.
hints.zh: 外面每一小段数一次，竖着的短台阶边也要数。

correct.en: Yes. The outside has 30 segments of 1 m each, so the perimeter is 30 m.
correct.zh: 对。外面一圈有 30 小段，每段 1 m，周长是 30 m。

say.en: 10 + 14 + 18 = 42 includes both sides of the 2 m and 4 m joins. Look at the traced outside segments only.
say.zh: 10 + 14 + 18 = 42 把 2 m 和 4 m 接缝的两侧也算了。只看描出的外边小段。

say.en: One traced segment lies inside the figure. Remove it and keep following the outside through every step.
say.zh: 你描的一小段在图形里面。去掉它，沿外边经过每个台阶。

fallback.en: Not yet. Follow the outline back to the start, check your traced segments, then add their lengths.
fallback.zh: 还没对。沿轮廓回到起点，检查描出的小段，再加总长度。

reveal.en: The perimeter is 9 + 6 + 3 + 2 + 3 + 2 + 3 + 2 = 30 m. Adding the pieces’ perimeters gives 42 m because both joins are counted on each side.
reveal.zh: 周长是 9 + 6 + 3 + 2 + 3 + 2 + 3 + 2 = 30 m。各块周长之和是 42 m，其中把两条接缝的两侧也算了。

prompt.en: Which calculation gives the perimeter of the three joined rectangles?
prompt.zh: 哪个算式求出三个长方形拼好后的周长？

guide.en: Use the three top lengths to find the whole length. Choose a calculation that goes round the outside once.
guide.zh: 用上方三段边长求出总长。选出只绕外面一圈的算式。

hints.en: Look at the outside of the long joined figure.
hints.zh: 看拼好后的长图形外面一圈。

hints.en: The total length is 5 + 4 + 6 = 15 cm; the breadth is 3 cm.
hints.zh: 总长是 5 + 4 + 6 = 15 cm，宽是 3 cm。

hints.en: You need two lengths and two breadths.
hints.zh: 你需要两个长和两个宽。

correct.en: Yes. 2 × (15 + 3) = 36 cm uses only the outside of the joined figure.
correct.zh: 对。2 × (15 + 3) = 36 cm 只算拼好后外面一圈。

say.en: 16 + 14 + 18 includes both sides of both joins. Look at the outside rectangle and use its total length and breadth.
say.zh: 16 + 14 + 18 把两条接缝的两侧也算了。看外面的长方形，用它的总长和宽。

say.en: 15 × 3 finds how much surface the figure covers. For perimeter, use the lengths that go round the outside.
say.zh: 15 × 3 求的是图形铺满的面积。求周长，要把外面一圈的边长相加。

fallback.en: Not yet. Choose the calculation that uses every outside side once.
fallback.zh: 还没对。选出把外面每条边算一次的算式。

reveal.en: The joined figure has length 15 cm and breadth 3 cm. Its perimeter is 2 × (15 + 3) = 36 cm.
reveal.zh: 拼好后的图形长 15 cm、宽 3 cm。周长是 2 × (15 + 3) = 36 cm。

prompt.en: Choose the perimeter of this L-shaped figure. Include the unlabelled sides.
prompt.zh: 选出这个 L 形图形的周长，包括没标长度的边。

guide.en: Find both unlabelled lengths by subtraction. Then compare the choices with the sum of all six outside sides.
guide.zh: 先用减法求出两条没标的边长。再把外面的六条边相加，与选项比较。

hints.en: Locate the two unlabelled sides at the inward corner.
hints.zh: 找出凹角旁边两条没标长度的边。

hints.en: Their lengths are 13 − 8 m and 8 − 5 m.
hints.zh: 它们分别是 13 − 8 和 8 − 5。

correct.en: Yes. The unlabelled sides are 5 m and 3 m, and all six sides give 42 m.
correct.zh: 对。没标的边是 5 m 和 3 m，六条边加起来是 42 m。

say.en: 34 m adds only the four labelled lengths. Include the two sides at the inward corner to complete the distance round.
say.zh: 34 m 只加了标出的四个边长。把凹角旁边两条边也加上，才走完一整圈。

say.en: 89 m² is the area covered by the figure. Look at the outside lengths to find the distance round in m.
say.zh: 89 m² 是铺满这个图形的面积。周长是绕外面一圈的长度，单位要用 m。

fallback.en: Not yet. Check all six sides and choose their total length.
fallback.zh: 还没对。检查六条边，选出它们的总长度。

reveal.en: The missing lengths are 13 − 8 = 5 m and 8 − 5 = 3 m. The perimeter is 13 + 8 + 8 + 3 + 5 + 5 = 42 m.

prompt.en: Find the area of the shaded figure. Lay the squares first, then write the area.
prompt.zh: 求涂色图形的面积。先铺上正方形，再写出面积。

guide.en: Lay a square on every whole square and every half. Two halves make one whole square.
guide.zh: 每个整格、每个半格都铺上。两个半格合起来是一个整格。

hints.en: Two half squares make one square.
hints.zh: 两个半格是一个整格。

correct.en: Yes. 8 whole squares and 2 halves: 8 + 1 = 9 cm².
correct.zh: 对。8 个整格加 2 个半格：8 + 1 = 9 cm²。

say.en: Each half square counts as half. The 2 halves make 1 square, not 2.
say.zh: 每个半格只算半格。2 个半格合起来是 1 格，不是 2 格。

say.en: 9 is right, but area is in square units: cm², not cm.
say.zh: 9 对了，可面积要用平方单位：cm²，不是 cm。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count the whole squares, then put the halves together.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先数整格，再把半格两个两个合起来。

reveal.en: 8 whole squares, and the 2 halves make 1 more: 9 cm².
reveal.zh: 8 个整格，2 个半格合成 1 格：9 cm²。

prompt.en: Trace the perimeter of the rectangle, then write it.
prompt.zh: 描出长方形的周长，再写出来。

guide.en: Trace every side of the squares along the outside edge, all the way round, then count them.
guide.zh: 把外边每个小格露在外面的边都描出来，走完一整圈，再数一数。

hints.en: Count sides, not squares: a corner square has two.
hints.zh: 数边，不数格子：角上的格子有两段。

correct.en: Yes. 4 + 3 + 4 + 3 = 14: the perimeter is 14 cm.

say.en: 10 counts the squares along the edge. Count their sides on the edge: corner squares have two.
say.zh: 10 是边上的格子数。要数露在外面的边：角上的格子有两段。

say.en: 12 is the number of squares inside: the area. The perimeter is the distance round.
say.zh: 12 是里面的格子数，那是面积。周长是绕一圈的长度。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count every side round the edge once.
fallback.zh: 还没对。外面一圈的每一段都数一次。

reveal.en: 14 sides of 1 cm go round the rectangle: 14 cm.
reveal.zh: 绕长方形一圈有 14 段，每段 1 cm：14 cm。

prompt.en: A rectangle has a length of 7 cm and a breadth of 4 cm. What is its area?
prompt.zh: 长方形长 7 cm、宽 4 cm，面积是多少？

guide.en: Area = length × breadth, in square units.
guide.zh: 面积 = 长 × 宽，用平方单位。

hints.en: 4 rows of 7 squares.
hints.zh: 4 行，每行 7 格。

correct.en: Yes. 7 × 4 = 28: the area is 28 cm².

say.en: 7 + 4 = 11 adds two lengths. Area counts squares: 4 rows of 7.
say.zh: 7 + 4 = 11 是把两条边加起来。面积数的是正方形：4 行，每行 7 个。

say.en: 22 is the perimeter, the distance round. Area is the squares inside: multiply.
say.zh: 22 是周长，绕一圈的长度。面积是里面的正方形：要相乘。

say.en: 28 is right, but cm is for a length. Area is in cm².
say.zh: 28 对了，可 cm 是长度单位。面积用 cm²。

fallback.en: Not yet. Multiply the length by the breadth and check the unit.
fallback.zh: 还没对。用长乘宽，再看看单位。

reveal.en: 7 × 4 = 28 squares of 1 cm²: 28 cm².

prompt.en: Find the perimeter of the L-shaped figure.
prompt.zh: 求 L 形的周长。

guide.en: Find the two unmarked sides from the sides opposite them, then add all six sides.
guide.zh: 先用对面的边求出两条没标的边，再把六条边加起来。

say.en: 24 adds only the four marked sides. Find the two unmarked ones and add them too.
say.zh: 24 只加了标出的四条边。把两条没标的边也求出来加上。

fallback.en: Not yet. Walk all the way round: there are 6 sides.
fallback.zh: 还没对。走完一整圈：一共 6 条边。

reveal.en: The missing sides are 4 cm and 2 cm: 9 + 4 + 4 + 2 + 5 + 6 = 30 cm.
reveal.zh: 没标的边是 4 cm 和 2 cm：9 + 4 + 4 + 2 + 5 + 6 = 30 cm。

prompt.en: Draw a rectangle with an area of 12 cm² and a perimeter of 16 cm.
prompt.zh: 画一个面积 12 cm²、周长 16 cm 的长方形。

guide.en: Several rectangles have an area of 12 cm². Walk round each one: only one has a perimeter of 16 cm.
guide.zh: 面积是 12 cm² 的长方形有好几个。各走一圈：只有一个周长是 16 cm。

hints.en: Try 6 by 2, 4 by 3 and 12 by 1.

say.en: 4 cm by 3 cm has the right area, 12 cm², but its perimeter is 14 cm. Same area does not mean same perimeter.
say.zh: 4 cm × 3 cm 的面积是 12 cm²，对；可周长是 14 cm。面积相同，周长不一定相同。

fallback.en: Not yet. Check both the squares inside and the way round.
fallback.zh: 还没对。里面的格子和外面一圈都要看。

reveal.en: A 6 cm by 2 cm rectangle: area 12 cm², perimeter 16 cm. 4 by 3 also has an area of 12, but its perimeter is 14.
reveal.zh: 长 6 cm、宽 2 cm 的长方形：面积 12 cm²，周长 16 cm。4 × 3 面积也是 12，周长却是 14。

prompt.en: A rectangular garden has a perimeter of 30 m and a length of 9 m. What is its breadth?
prompt.zh: 长方形花园周长 30 m，长 9 m，宽是多少？

guide.en: Half the perimeter is one length and one breadth.
guide.zh: 周长的一半是一条长加一条宽。

hints.en: 30 ÷ 2 = 15 is one length and one breadth.
hints.zh: 30 ÷ 2 = 15 是一条长加一条宽。

say.en: 30 − 9 = 21 is the other three sides together. Halve the perimeter first.
say.zh: 30 − 9 = 21 是另外三条边的和。先把周长除以 2。

fallback.en: Not yet. Start from half the perimeter.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先求周长的一半。

reveal.en: Half of 30 m is 15 m; 15 − 9 = 6 m.

prompt.en: A square has a perimeter of 28 cm. What is its area?
prompt.zh: 正方形周长 28 cm，面积是多少？

guide.en: First find the side: 4 equal sides make 28 cm. Then area = side × side.
guide.zh: 先求边长：4 条一样长的边合起来是 28 cm。再算面积 = 边长 × 边长。

hints.en: Side = 28 ÷ 4.

correct.en: Yes. The side is 28 ÷ 4 = 7 cm, so the area is 7 × 7 = 49 cm².
correct.zh: 对。边长是 28 ÷ 4 = 7 cm，面积是 7 × 7 = 49 cm²。

say.en: 196 uses a side of 14 cm, half the perimeter. A square has 4 equal sides: divide by 4.
say.zh: 196 用的边长是 14 cm，是周长的一半。正方形有 4 条一样长的边，要除以 4。

say.en: 28 is the perimeter, the distance round. The area is the squares inside.
say.zh: 28 是周长，绕一圈的长度。面积是里面的正方形。

say.en: 49 is right, but area is in cm², not cm.
say.zh: 49 对了，可面积用 cm²，不是 cm。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find the side first, then multiply.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先求边长，再相乘。

reveal.en: 28 ÷ 4 = 7 cm a side; 7 × 7 = 49 cm².

prompt.en: Cut the floor plan into two rectangles, then find its area.
prompt.zh: 把平面图切成两个长方形，再求面积。

guide.en: Cut along a grid line so that both pieces are rectangles, then add their areas.
guide.zh: 沿一条格线切开，让两块都是长方形，再把面积相加。

hints.en: A cut up and down at the step works.
hints.zh: 在台阶那里竖着切一刀就行。

correct.en: Yes. The two pieces add up to 51 m².
correct.zh: 对。两块加起来是 51 m²。

say.en: 35 + 36 counts the overlapping corner twice. Use two pieces that do not overlap.
say.zh: 35 + 36 把重叠的角算了两次。用两块不重叠的长方形。

fallback.en: Not yet. Add the areas of your two pieces.
fallback.zh: 还没对。把你切出的两块的面积加起来。
